nodes.name: Anvil & The Abecean Harbor
nodes.description: Picturesque coastal port city on the Abecean Sea; seat of Countess Millona Umbranox and haven for sailors, pirates, and the Gray Fox.

nodes.name: Kvatch & The Burning Ruins
nodes.description: Citadel plateau laid waste by the first Oblivion Gate; Savlian Matius and Brother Martin defend surviving refugees in the Chapel of Akatosh.

nodes.name: Skingrad & Castle Hassildor
nodes.description: Gothic stone bridges, cobbled ramparts, and sprawling Surilie and Tamika vineyards; secretly ruled by the vampire Count Janus Hassildor.

nodes.name: Chorrol & The Great Oak
nodes.description: Highland Colovian stronghold home to Countess Arriana Valga, Castle Chorrol, and the honorable Knights of the White Stallion.

nodes.name: Bruma & The Great Gate Basin
nodes.description: Snowbound Nord frontier town beneath the Jerall peaks; ruled by Countess Narina Carvain and site of the climactic Great Gate battle.

nodes.name: Cheydinhal & Willow Bank
nodes.description: Dunmer-styled timber city nestled near the Morrowind border; Count Andel Indarys' town conceals the Dark Brotherhood sanctuary well.

nodes.name: Bravil & The Lucky Old Lady
nodes.description: Ramshackle canal settlement of rotting wood and skooma dens; the bronze statue of the Lucky Old Lady marks the crypt of the Night Mother.

nodes.name: Leyawiin & The Niben Delta
nodes.description: Fortified delta crossroads bordered by Elsweyr and Black Marsh; beset by ethnic tension, the count's court, and Blackwood Company mercenaries.

nodes.name: Weynon Priory & Chapel of Saint Jiub
nodes.description: Rustic monastic abbey near Chorrol; Prior Jauffre's covert command post for the Order of the Blades.
nodes.displayName: Weynon Priory & Chapel of Saint Jiub

nodes.name: Cloud Ruler Temple (Blades Fortress)
nodes.description: Impregnable Akaviri mountain fortress looking south across Cyrodiil; safe haven for Martin Septim and the royal Blades garrison.

nodes.name: Sancre Tor & Holy Crypt of Talos
nodes.description: Ancient mountain necropolis holding the tombs of Reman emperors and the consecrated armor of General Tiber Septim.
nodes.displayName: Sancre Tor & Holy Crypt of Talos

nodes.name: Miscarcand & Great Welkynd Vault
nodes.description: Massive Ayleid ruins guarded by undead liches and the cursed King of Miscarcand; houses the radiant Great Welkynd Stone.

nodes.name: Vilverin & Lake Rumare Shore
nodes.description: Ancient lakeside Ayleid ruins directly opposite the Imperial Prison sewers; notorious haven for outlaws, traps, and necromancers.

nodes.name: Hackdirt & The Subterranean Brethren
nodes.description: Sinister, hostile hamlet whose xenophobic residents sacrifice travelers to ancient chthonic entities known as 'The Deep Ones'.

nodes.name: Applewatch Farm & Orchard
nodes.description: Remote hillside farmstead; tragic site where the Black Hand brutally tortures and executes Speaker Lucien Lachance under false pretenses.

nodes.name: Frostcrag Spire & Astral Tower
nodes.description: Enchanted crystalline wizard tower crowning the highest glacial ridge east of Bruma, containing a private alchemy garden and portal vault.

nodes.name: Lake Arrius & Mythic Dawn Citadel
nodes.description: Subterranean grotto temple where Mankar Camoran consecrated the Mysterium Xarxes and rallied his sleeper cultists.

nodes.name: Water's Edge & The Hist Clearing
nodes.description: Peaceful settlement along the Lower Niben destroyed when the Blackwood Company, intoxicated on corrupted Hist sap, butchered the town.

nodes.name: Echo Cave & Seat of the Necromancers
nodes.description: Cavernous underground necropolis where Mannimarco, King of Worms, marshals his undead thralls against the Arcane University.
nodes.displayName: Echo Cave & Seat of the Necromancers

demographics.primary: Order of the Black Worm Necromancers

nodes.name: Shrine of Azura & Silverfish Ridge
nodes.description: Majestic mountaintop statue overlooking the eastern mountains; Azura bestows her infinite soul-gem Star upon pious pilgrims.

nodes.name: Imperial Prison & Subterrane
nodes.description: Subterranean dungeons and escape conduits beneath the capital; site of Uriel Septim VII's assassination and the start of the Hero's journey.

nodes.name: White-Gold Tower & Elder Council
nodes.description: Ancient colossal spire at the center of Tamriel; houses High Chancellor Ocato, the Elder Council Chambers, and the Imperial Library.

nodes.name: Temple of the One (The Dragonfires)
nodes.description: Sacred domed cathedral housing the Dragonfires altar; the cosmic fulcrum where Martin Septim shatters the Amulet to summon Akatosh.

demographics.primary: Priests of the Eight and One & Worshippers

nodes.name: Imperial Waterfront & Dareloth Garden
nodes.description: Squalid docks outside the southern wall; domain of the beggars, lighthouse guards, and midnight rendezvous point of the Thieves Guild.

nodes.name: Arcane University & Council of Mages
nodes.description: Spired academy of spellcraft, enchanting, and alchemy; headquarters of Arch-Mage Hannibal Traven and the Mages Guild council.

nodes.name: Imperial Arena & Bloodworks
nodes.description: Ancient gladiatorial amphitheater where crowds wager fortunes and combatants duel to the death against the Gray Prince.

nodes.name: Market District & Merchants Gate
nodes.description: Bustling commercial nexus of the Empire; home to Jensine's Good as New Goods and Thoronir's cut-rate unwholesome merchandise.

nodes.name: The Deadlands & Kvatch Sigil Keep
nodes.description: Abyssal lava plains under Mehrunes Dagon; towering spiked citadels, blood fountains, and the Sigil Stone anchoring the Kvatch breach.

nodes.name: The Great Gate & Siege Citadel
nodes.description: Immense Deadlands fortress protecting the colossal Daedric Siege Crawler; closed by extracting the Great Sigil Stone under strict timer.

nodes.name: Gaiar Alata (Mankar Camoran's Paradise)
nodes.description: Surreal twilight paradise crafted by the Mysterium Xarxes; immortal cultists suffer eternal torment until Camoran falls in Carac Agaialor.

creatures.name: Scamp Skirmisher
creatures.summary: Mischievous and pyromaniac lesser Daedra of Mehrunes Dagon that swarm invaders with chattering shrieks and bursts of fire.

senses.blindspots: Narrow stereoscopic forward vision; susceptible to flanking.

disposition.ethologySummary: Chaotic skirmish pack (S:3), Opportunistic Scavenger (E:1), Volatile Instinct (C:2)

gigerenzerBehavior.dreadEffect: Chattering cries and sudden sulfur flashes erode enemy focus and scatter pack animals.

heuristicProfile.stoppingRule: Cast firebolt if at range; flee and chatter if cornered in melee.

cues.label: Is enemy beyond 15 feet?
cues.exitLabel: Hurl firebolt

cues.label: Is health below 30%?
cues.exitLabel: Flee chattering into shadows

defaultExit.label: Scratch with venomous claws

signatureActions.name: Lesser Firebolt
signatureActions.effect: Launches a sulfurous orb of planar flame dealing minor fire burn.

signatureActions.name: Chattering Shriek
signatureActions.effect: Disorients mortal targets with infernal pitch.

vernacularFolklore: Common pest of the Deadlands; dangerous in packs of five or more.

creatures.name: Clannfear Shock Beast
creatures.summary: Bipedal saurian Daedra with armored bony crests, ferocious leaping charges, and razor-sharp talons.

senses.blindspots: Blind directly behind head crest.

disposition.ethologySummary: Pack hunter (S:2), Territorial Hunter (E:2), Savage Instinct (C:1)

gigerenzerBehavior.dreadEffect: Thundering footfalls and guttural hissing shatter morale of frontline infantry.

heuristicProfile.stoppingRule: Headbutt sprint charge on first clear path.

cues.label: Is charge path unobstructed?
cues.exitLabel: Deliver devastating leaping charge

cues.label: Is target knocked down?
cues.exitLabel: Tear with raptor talons

defaultExit.label: Circle and seek weak flank

signatureActions.name: Battering Headbutt
signatureActions.effect: Deals heavy physical bludgeoning and knocks mortal targets prone.

signatureActions.name: Raptor Rend
signatureActions.effect: Rips through light armor with foot talons.

vernacularFolklore: Regarded by Imperial legionnaires as the shock hounds of Oblivion.

creatures.name: Daedroth Juggernaut
creatures.summary: Massive bipedal reptilian brute breathing torrents of emerald flame and crushing shields with colossal jaws.

senses.blindspots: Rear quadrant limited by massive muscular neck.

anatomicalWeakSpots: Soft palate when maw opens to exhale fire.

disposition.ethologySummary: Solitary alpha predator (S:1), Territorial Domain (E:3), Brutal Strength (C:1)

gigerenzerBehavior.dreadEffect: Concussive roars shake masonry; soldiers experience overwhelming panic.

heuristicProfile.stoppingRule: Exhale flame if multiple targets; otherwise crush nearest with maw.

cues.label: Are enemies tightly grouped?
cues.exitLabel: Unleash cone of emerald hellfire

cues.label: Is enemy within arm span?
cues.exitLabel: Clamp down with crushing jaw pressure

defaultExit.label: Smash fists into ground causing tremors

signatureActions.name: Emerald Fire Breath
signatureActions.effect: Incinerates flesh and armor with Daedric green flame.

signatureActions.name: Bone-Crushing Bite
signatureActions.effect: Snaps limbs and fractures shields.

vernacularFolklore: Molag Bal and Mehrunes Dagon both employ these hulks as breach engines.

creatures.name: Spider Daedra Weaver
creatures.summary: Centauric horrors combining an armored arachnid torso with a humanoid sorceress, summoning broodlings and spinning paralyzing webs.

senses.blindspots: Virtually none due to multi-faceted eyes and web vibrations.

anatomicalWeakSpots: Soft humanoid joint connecting torso to abdomen.

disposition.ethologySummary: Matriarchal Hive Queen (S:3), Lair Domain (E:2), Calculating Sorcery (C:4)

gigerenzerBehavior.dreadEffect: Creeping skitter and silken web traps instill paralyzing arachnophobia.

heuristicProfile.stoppingRule: Summon Spiderling broodling first, then ensnare and paralyze target.

cues.label: Are zero spiderlings active?
cues.exitLabel: Spit egg sac summoning voracious broodling

cues.label: Is primary target mobile?
cues.exitLabel: Hurl venomous glob causing complete paralysis

defaultExit.label: Discharge planar shock bolt from claws

signatureActions.name: Broodling Spasm
signatureActions.effect: Summons a chittering Spiderling that swarms and poisons target.

signatureActions.name: Venomous Paralyzing Spit
signatureActions.effect: Paralyzes nervous system of living targets for 10 seconds.

instinctiveQuirks: Mocks victims with sibilant female whispers
Wraps defeated prey in cocoon silk
vernacularFolklore: Dedicated to Mephala originally, but pledged in droves to Dagon's invasion.

creatures.name: Xivilai Demonic Berserker
creatures.summary: Towering, proud warlords wielding two-handed claymores with one hand, absorbing enemy spells and summoning Clannfear into battle.

senses.blindspots: Overconfident; ignores minor threats.

disposition.ethologySummary: Independent Warlord (S:1), Sovereign Conqueror (E:4), Ruthless Arrogance (C:4)

gigerenzerBehavior.dreadEffect: Spells are swallowed harmlessly by its aura, driving mages to despair.

heuristicProfile.stoppingRule: Summon Clannfear vanguard, absorb spells, cleave mortals in half.

cues.label: Has pet Clannfear perished or not present?
cues.exitLabel: Call forth bound Clannfear shock beast

cues.label: Is enemy casting arcana?
cues.exitLabel: Absorb spell energy into reserves

defaultExit.label: Cleave with two-handed claymore wielded in single hand

signatureActions.name: Planar Claymore Cleave
signatureActions.effect: Massive sweeping arc cutting through multiple armored foes.

signatureActions.name: Spell Absorption & Reflection
signatureActions.effect: Absorbs magicka from hostile spells to replenish own reserves.

instinctiveQuirks: Refuses to bow to any master, even Dremora Kyn
vernacularFolklore: Feared even by high-ranking Dremora as rebellious, peerless warriors.

creatures.name: Dremora Valkynaz Praetorian
creatures.summary: Elite Daedric knights encrusted in ebony-forged spikes, operating with rigid tactical discipline under the Sigil of Mehrunes Dagon.

senses.blindspots: Helmet visor narrows extreme peripheral vision.

anatomicalWeakSpots: Neck seam between gorget and helm.

disposition.ethologySummary: Martial Caste Hierarchy (S:4), Strategic Outpost (E:4), Iron Discipline (C:4)

gigerenzerBehavior.dreadEffect: Cold military precision and utter fearlessness break enemy formations.

heuristicProfile.stoppingRule: Execute formation tactics, crush mortal champions.

cues.label: Is enemy champion closing distance?
cues.exitLabel: Engage in ritual martial duel with enchanted mace

cues.label: Is allied line threatened by archers/mages?
cues.exitLabel: Charge through missiles and break backline

defaultExit.label: Execute calculated lethal weapon strike

signatureActions.name: Spiked Daedric Mace Strike
signatureActions.effect: Crushes armor plate and inflicts fire and shock enchantments.

signatureActions.name: Kyn Command Aura
signatureActions.effect: Prevents nearby Scamps and Clannfear from routing.

instinctiveQuirks: Speaks in formal, severe Daedric poetry
vocalizations: 'I will feast on your heart, mortal!'
vernacularFolklore: Highest rank of Dremora field commanders below the Princes themselves.

creatures.name: Flame Atronach
creatures.summary: Floating humanoid manifestations of pure fire and dark basalt, detonating in a cataclysmic firestorm upon death.

senses.blindspots: Cannot perceive targets with zero body heat or frozen aura.

disposition.ethologySummary: Elemental Solitary (S:1), Thermal Beacon (E:2), Elemental Nature (C:1)

gigerenzerBehavior.dreadEffect: Intense radiant heat singes eyebrows and dries canteens at 20 paces.

heuristicProfile.stoppingRule: Strafe at range with fireballs; detonate upon destruction.

cues.label: Has hit point total reached zero?
cues.exitLabel: Detonate core in lethal fiery explosion

cues.label: Is target beyond 10 paces?
cues.exitLabel: Hover and hurl tracking fire orbs

defaultExit.label: Ignite attacker with radiant fire cloak

signatureActions.name: Death Detonation
signatureActions.effect: Explodes in a 15ft radius blast dealing heavy fire damage to all nearby.

signatureActions.name: Fireball Barrage
signatureActions.effect: Hurls continuous stream of incendiary fireballs.

vernacularFolklore: Inhabitants of Infernace; favored summons of pyromancers across Tamriel.

creatures.name: King of Miscarcand (Ayleid Lich)
creatures.summary: Ancient undead ruler of the Miscarcand ruins, hovering amidst floating Welkynd shards and casting lethal high-tier frost and shock arcana.

senses.blindspots: Arrogant tunnel vision focused on spell intruders.

defenses.armorType: ancient ayleid ceremonial robes and sorcerous ward
anatomicalWeakSpots: Phylactery Welkynd stone hovering at chest.

disposition.ethologySummary: Undead Sovereign (S:1), Ancient Royal Domain (E:4), Imperious Arcana (C:4)

gigerenzerBehavior.dreadEffect: Ancient Aldmeri curses chill blood in veins; lights flicker and die.

heuristicProfile.stoppingRule: Raise Ayleid skeleton guards, channel blizzard spell, protect Great Stone.

cues.label: Are zero undead thralls active?
cues.exitLabel: Animate ancient Ayleid retainers from sarcophagi

cues.label: Is intruder reaching for the Great Welkynd Stone?
cues.exitLabel: Unleash devastating freezing blizzard vortex

defaultExit.label: Cast corroding shock bolt that degrades armor

signatureActions.name: Wrath of Miscarcand
signatureActions.effect: Massive frost nova that freezes flesh and slows movement by 80%.

signatureActions.name: Welkynd Drain
signatureActions.effect: Drains magicka directly from nearby spellcasters to refill own pool.

instinctiveQuirks: Never sets foot on physical ground
vernacularFolklore: Ruled the county of Miscarcand before the Alessian Slave Rebellion.

creatures.name: Will-o'-the-Wisp
creatures.summary: Ghostly bioluminescent orb immune to non-magical weapons that drains the stamina and life essence of unwary wanderers in swamps and ruins.

senses.blindspots: None; spherical awareness.

disposition.ethologySummary: Solitary Lure Hunter (S:1), Wetland Domain (E:2), Spectral Deception (C:2)

gigerenzerBehavior.dreadEffect: Lures travelers into deep bogs; conventional blades pass harmlessly through its body.

heuristicProfile.stoppingRule: Lure target deeper into mire, then drain life and stamina simultaneously.

cues.label: Is target following light into hazards?
cues.exitLabel: Flicker and lead victim deeper into quicksand

cues.label: Is victim within 5 paces?
cues.exitLabel: Suck life energy directly through skin

defaultExit.label: Turn translucent and vanish into fog

signatureActions.name: Essence Siphon
signatureActions.effect: Drains 20 points of Health and 30 points of Fatigue every second.

signatureActions.name: Ghostly Translucence
signatureActions.effect: Fades into near-invisibility for 5 seconds to relocate.

instinctiveQuirks: Imitates lantern lights of lost travelers
vocalizations: Soft melodic chime like glass bells
vernacularFolklore: Folk tell tales of spirits of murdered infants; scholars deem them planar parasites.

creatures.name: Land Dreugh
creatures.summary: Terrestrial phase of the ancient Dreugh race, lurching on four armored claws and discharging devastating electrical shocks from its carapace.

senses.blindspots: Directly underneath heavy armored thorax.

disposition.ethologySummary: Tide-pool clan (S:2), Coastal Estuary (E:2), Ancient Caste (C:2)

gigerenzerBehavior.dreadEffect: Snapping pincers and static crackle cause horses to rear and bolt.

heuristicProfile.stoppingRule: Discharge carapace shock into metal armor, snap pincers.

cues.label: Is electrical carapace fully charged?
cues.exitLabel: Release arc of lightning through victim's metal armor

cues.label: Is foe within pincer reach?
cues.exitLabel: Sever limb with heavy serrated pincer

defaultExit.label: Raise twin armored forelimbs into defensive ward

signatureActions.name: Static Carapace Arc
signatureActions.effect: Discharges stored bio-electricity dealing heavy shock damage.

signatureActions.name: Serrating Pincer Grip
signatureActions.effect: Clamps victim with crushing force, disabling held weapons.

instinctiveQuirks: Aggressive during Molag Bal holy days
vernacularFolklore: Once ruled Tamriel before mortal races arose; now diminished to beasts.

creatures.name: Minotaur Lord of Sancre Tor
creatures.summary: Towering horned titan descended from the holy bull Morihaus, wielding colossal two-handed warhammers and shattering battlelines with gore charges.

senses.blindspots: Lateral peripheral vision limited by massive curled horns.

defenses.armorType: thick hide and ancient bronze harness

disposition.ethologySummary: Sacred Guardian Tribe (S:3), Sancre Tor Sacred Valley (E:3), Martial Honor (C:3)

gigerenzerBehavior.dreadEffect: Ground-shaking bellow and thunderous hoof beats scatter pack animals and break shield walls.

heuristicProfile.stoppingRule: Battering ram bull rush through shield wall; smash hammer downward.

cues.label: Is distance to target greater than 20 feet?
cues.exitLabel: Lower horns and execute devastating sprint charge

cues.label: Is enemy defending with shield or block?
cues.exitLabel: Shatter guard with colossal downward warhammer blow

defaultExit.label: Toss opponent into air with horn sweep

signatureActions.name: Horn Gore Rush
signatureActions.effect: Gores target for lethal piercing damage and tosses body 20 feet.

signatureActions.name: Titan Warhammer Slam
signatureActions.effect: Destroys shields and inflicts concussive stagger.

instinctiveQuirks: Pawes dirt with hooves before charging
vernacularFolklore: Regarded by Imperials as fallen cousins descended from Queen Alessia and Morihaus.

creatures.name: Painted Troll of Cheydinhal
creatures.summary: Oil-pigment monstrosities spawned inside Rythe Lythandas's enchanted canvas, vulnerable only to the solvent touch of Turpentine.

senses.blindspots: Directly behind thick hunched shoulders.

anatomicalWeakSpots: Dissolves instantly upon contact with Turpentine solvent.

disposition.ethologySummary: Artificial Canvas Beast (S:1), Studio Realm (E:1), Feral Slime (C:1)

gigerenzerBehavior.dreadEffect: Wounds knit together with wet paint strokes; weapons stick harmlessly in its pigment body.

heuristicProfile.stoppingRule: Flail claws relentlessly; flee only if solvent burns paint flesh.

cues.label: Has weapon been coated in Turpentine?
cues.exitLabel: Screech and retreat as paint flesh dissolves

cues.label: Is opponent within reach of long arms?
cues.exitLabel: Rake with thick pigment-dripping claws

defaultExit.label: Smear wounds with surrounding oil paint to heal

signatureActions.name: Turpentine Vulnerability
signatureActions.effect: Suffers 100 points of solvent burn and loses regenerative skin.

signatureActions.name: Pigment Regeneration
signatureActions.effect: Re-knits 15 points of Health as oil colors flow over tears.

instinctiveQuirks: Drips wet linseed oil wherever it treads
spoorAndSigns: Wet multi-colored paint streaks on leaves and trees
vernacularFolklore: Born of an enchanted brush given by Dibella gone mad inside an easel.

creatures.name: Gloom Wraith of Echo Cave
creatures.summary: Terrifying apparitions draped in tattered burial shrouds, wielding ancient silver claymores and emitting silence curses.

senses.blindspots: Narrow focused hate on radiant auras.

disposition.ethologySummary: Undead Crypt Warden (S:1), Necromantic Crypt (E:3), Chilling Malice (C:4)

gigerenzerBehavior.dreadEffect: Guttural ghostly shriek inflicts magical silence, rendering spellcasters helpless.

heuristicProfile.stoppingRule: Curse mages with silence, drift through obstacles, decapitate with spectral claymore.

cues.label: Is enemy attempting to cast arcana?
cues.exitLabel: Emit unholy shriek sealing enemy vocal cords

cues.label: Is enemy using non-magical steel blade?
cues.exitLabel: Let weapon pass through vapor, then counter-strike

defaultExit.label: Deliver chilling frost-imbued claymore slash

signatureActions.name: Curse of Silence
signatureActions.effect: Silences all enemies within 30ft for 15 seconds.

signatureActions.name: Ectoplasmic Frost Blade
signatureActions.effect: Inflicts cold damage and siphons Endurance attribute.

instinctiveQuirks: Hovers silently 2 feet above stone floor
Fades into tomb walls when cornered
spoorAndSigns: Rime of frost on tomb door handles
vernacularFolklore: Ancient Necromancers of Mannimarco bind these vengeful spirits to guard their black altars.

creatures.name: Shadowmere (Vampiric Steed)
creatures.summary: Supernatural midnight stallion gifted by Lucien Lachance, possessing demonic endurance, unyielding aggression against enemies, and rapid health regeneration.

senses.blindspots: Directly behind hindquarters.

disposition.ethologySummary: Bound Dark Brotherhood Familiar (S:4), Highroad Steed (E:2), Unshakable Devotion (C:4)

gigerenzerBehavior.dreadEffect: Fiery red eyes and midnight coat strike terror into assassins and road bandits.

heuristicProfile.stoppingRule: Trample master's assailants with ferocious hooves; never route or retreat.

cues.label: Is master currently engaged in combat?
cues.exitLabel: Rear and crush foe with supernatural iron-shod hooves

cues.label: Has steed taken mortal injury?
cues.exitLabel: Fall unconscious briefly then awaken fully restored

defaultExit.label: Gallop with unmatched supernatural swiftness

signatureActions.name: Supernatural Trample
signatureActions.effect: Rears and smashes hooves down on enemies, dealing heavy bludgeoning.

signatureActions.name: Shadow Immortality
signatureActions.effect: Collapses unconscious rather than dying, reviving to full vitality in minutes.

instinctiveQuirks: Ferociously attacks anyone who harms its master
spoorAndSigns: Hoofprints smoldering with purple shadow mist
vernacularFolklore: Gift of Sithis to the Listener of the Black Hand; cannot truly be killed.

npcs.name: Brother Martin / Martin Septim
npcs.role: Priest of Akatosh / Heir to the Ruby Throne
npcs.motivation: Accept the burden of the Septim bloodline and atone for his Sanguine cult youth through total self-sacrifice to rekindle the Dragonfires.

secretsKnown.secret: In his youth, Martin was lured into a Sanguine revel house where a friend died during a dark ritual he chanted. He secretly keeps a rosewood Sanguine prayer bead in his breviary.

leverage.vulnerability: Guilt over his Daedric past and fear of becoming a tyrant like Camoran warns.
leverage.bribe: Absolution and honest spiritual counsel; immune to wealth.

dialogueHooks: Voice Tell: "Do not call me Majesty yet. I have not earned the word, and the word has not earned me. Let me be Brother Martin a little while longer."
Crucible Reaction: "If the party offers him absolution and support, he steps into the Avatar fire without hesitation. If shamed or isolated, his resolve falters."

stationing.role: Last Living Heir to the Septim Dynasty

npcs.notes:
**Character & Station:** Brother Martin (`character_brother_martin`), Priest of Akatosh at Kvatch; illegitimate son of Uriel Septim VII.

**Psychological Matrix:** Want: quiet atonement as a monk. Need: accept sacral monarchical martyrdom to save Nirn. Primal Wound: death of his companion Terennus during youthful Sanguine cult revels in Colovia.

relationships.notes: reciprocal of the tie recorded on the other side

npcs.name: Grandmaster Jauffre
npcs.role: Grandmaster of the Order of the Blades / Prior of Weynon
npcs.motivation: Fulfill his sacred oath to protect the Septim dynasty at all costs, even if it requires breaking his monk's peace and sacrificing every Blade.

secretsKnown.secret: Jauffre hid Martin in Kvatch thirty years ago without the Elder Council's knowledge, and hid the Amulet of Kings in an unwarded desk drawer at Weynon Priory.

leverage.vulnerability: The survival of the Septim bloodline and guilt over Blades fallen under his command.
leverage.bribe: Unflinching martial loyalty and ancient Akaviri relics.

dialogueHooks: Voice Tell: "Speaks in clipped, gravelly monastic tones that carry the unmistakable steel of a lifetime in armor."
Crucible Reaction: "Under extreme crisis, he draws Dragonfire's Edge and charges to defend Martin at the cost of his own life."
npcs.notes: **Character & Station:** Grandmaster Jauffre (`character_jauffre`), Prior of Weynon Priory and supreme military commander of the Blades.

npcs.name: Baurus
npcs.motivation: Atone for failing to prevent Emperor Uriel Septim's death by hunting down the Mythic Dawn sleeper network in the Imperial City.

secretsKnown.secret: Knows the secret labyrinthine tunnels beneath the Imperial Prison and the identities of high-ranking Mythic Dawn sympathizers in the city watch.

leverage.vulnerability: Survivor's guilt from the Emperor's assassination in the catacombs.
leverage.bribe: Verifiable intelligence on Mythic Dawn safehouses.

dialogueHooks: Voice Tell: "Blunt, watchful, never sits with his back to a door, speaks in low conspiratorial undertones."
Crucible Reaction: "Holds the sewer gates against overwhelming odds to allow the Hero and Martin to escape."
npcs.notes: **Character & Station:** Baurus (`character_baurus`), the sole surviving Blade from the Emperor's subterranean bodyguard detail.

npcs.name: High Chancellor Ocato
npcs.role: High Chancellor of the Elder Council & Imperial Regent
npcs.motivation: Maintain the brittle political integrity of the Empire and prevent civil war while refusing to pull Legion garrisons from the provinces.

secretsKnown.secret: Provincial rebellions in Morrowind, Black Marsh, and Summerset Isle are so severe that the Empire has effectively lost control of its outer borders.

leverage.vulnerability: Fear of an Elder Council coup or provincial secession.
leverage.bribe: Military reinforcements from county counts or provincial pacification.

dialogueHooks: Voice Tell: "Refined Altmer cadence, exhausted diplomatic precision, weighs every word as if drafting an imperial treaty."
Crucible Reaction: "Unsheathes battlemage lightning to defend the Elder Council Chambers when Daedra storm the palace."
npcs.notes: **Character & Station:** High Chancellor Ocato (`character_ocato`), de facto head of state governing from the White-Gold Tower.

npcs.name: Mankar Camoran
npcs.role: Mastermind of the Mythic Dawn & Prophet of Mehrunes Dagon
npcs.motivation: Cleanse Tamriel in holy fire and dissolve the mortal veil of Mundus so that Mehrunes Dagon can reclaim his rightful primordial realm.

secretsKnown.secret: His pocket paradise Gaiar Alata was forged from his own soul through the Mysterium Xarxes; slaying him instantly collapses the entire dimensional plane.

leverage.vulnerability: The metaphysical anchor tying his immortality to the Mysterium Xarxes and his twin children.
leverage.bribe: None; completely zealously devoted to Dagon.

dialogueHooks: Voice Tell: "Silken, hypnotic, cosmic sermons that weave complex theological heresies into irresistible promises of rebirth."
Crucible Reaction: "Laughs in transcendent ecstasy as his palace disintegrates around him, welcoming Dagon's return."
npcs.notes: **Character & Station:** Mankar Camoran (`character_mankar_camoran`), author of the Commentaries and arch-architect of the Oblivion Crisis.

npcs.name: Ruma Camoran
npcs.role: High Priestess of the Dawn & Daughter of Mankar
npcs.motivation: Serve her father's vision of cosmic rebirth and guard the portal conduits to Gaiar Alata.

secretsKnown.secret: She and her twin brother Raven are bound to an endless resurrection cycle in Paradise; killing one empowers the other until their anchor clock breaks.

leverage.vulnerability: Her twin bond with Raven.
leverage.bribe: Esoteric Daedric rites.

dialogueHooks: Voice Tell: "Fierce, fanatical conviction; regards mortal flesh as a fleeting illusion to be purified in blood."
Crucible Reaction: "Channels destructive shock magic into incoming attackers while shielding her twin."
npcs.notes: **Character & Station:** Ruma Camoran (`character_ruma_camoran`), daughter and high priestess of Mankar Camoran.

npcs.name: Raven Camoran
npcs.role: Inquisitor of the Dawn & Son of Mankar
npcs.motivation: Execute his father's purges while harboring secret doubts about the eternal agony inflicted upon the 'ascended' mortals in Paradise.

secretsKnown.secret: Raven secretly covets escape from his father's madness and will bargain with invaders if guaranteed permanent release from Dagon's grip.

leverage.vulnerability: Exhaustion from endless dying and resurrection in Paradise.
leverage.bribe: Safe passage to a mortal sanctuary on Nirn.

dialogueHooks: Voice Tell: "Brooding, cynical, glances at the blood gardens of Paradise with quiet revulsion."
Crucible Reaction: "If offered a true escape route, he lowers his daggers and yields the vault key."
npcs.notes: **Character & Station:** Raven Camoran (`character_raven_camoran`), son and executioner of Mankar Camoran.

npcs.name: Mannimarco, The King of Worms
npcs.motivation: Annihilate the Mages Guild, shatter Arch-Mage Traven's ban on necromancy, and absorb Traven's soul into a black soul gem to ascend as a cosmic deity.

secretsKnown.secret: Traven's sacrifice and self-imprisonment in a colossal black soul gem renders the bearer completely immune to Mannimarco's mind-control spells.

leverage.vulnerability: Hubris and reliance on the Necromancer's Moon celestial conjunction.
leverage.bribe: Colossal black soul gems or forbidden Ayleid relics.

dialogueHooks: Voice Tell: "Hollow, resonant, timeless chill like dust stirring over ancient sarcophagi."
Crucible Reaction: "Summons skeletal colossi and casts waves of death magic when his spell-absorb wards are breached."
npcs.notes: **Character & Station:** Mannimarco (`character_mannimarco`), ancient Altmer necromancer and leader of the Order of the Black Worm.

npcs.name: Mathieu Bellamont
npcs.role: First Blade of the Black Hand & The Traitor Defiler
npcs.motivation: Avenge his mother's murder by Lucien Lachance by systematically corrupting the Brotherhood's contracts and framing Lachance as a traitor.

secretsKnown.secret: He preserves his mother's severed head at Applewatch Farm and writes the forged dead-drop orders using her blood as ink.

leverage.vulnerability: The desecrated crypt of his mother at Applewatch.
leverage.bribe: None; consumed by psychotic revenge.

dialogueHooks: Voice Tell: "Smooth, obedient deference in public that curdles into sneering vindictive fury in shadow."
Crucible Reaction: "Leaps at the Night Mother's crypt with dagger drawn, completely heedless of mortal danger."
npcs.notes: **Character & Station:** Mathieu Bellamont (`character_mathieu_bellamont`), the traitor who orchestrated the purification of the Black Hand.
npcs.faction: The Dark Brotherhood & The Black Hand

npcs.name: Lucien Lachance
npcs.motivation: Enforce the Five Tenets of Sithis, purge the Cheydinhal sanctuary of suspected treason, and protect the Night Mother.

secretsKnown.secret: He suspects that someone inside the Black Hand is poisoning the contract dead-drops, but remains blind to Mathieu Bellamont's deception until it is too late.

leverage.vulnerability: Devotion to Sithis and absolute reverence for the Night Mother.
leverage.bribe: Flawless execution of sanctioned contracts.

dialogueHooks: Voice Tell: "Velvet, theatrical menace; appears silently from the darkest shadows when murder has taken place."
Crucible Reaction: "If warned in time with hard proof, he rallies loyal Silencers to butcher Bellamont at Applewatch."
npcs.notes: **Character & Station:** Lucien Lachance (`character_lucien_lachance`), Speaker of the Dark Brotherhood.
npcs.faction: The Dark Brotherhood & The Black Hand

npcs.name: The Gray Fox / Count Corvus Umbranox
npcs.role: Grandmaster of the Thieves Guild / Count of Anvil
npcs.motivation: Steal an Elder Scroll from the Imperial Palace Library to break the curse of Nocturnal's Cowl and return to his beloved wife Countess Millona Umbranox.

secretsKnown.secret: The Cowl erases the wearer's true name and history from mortal memory; his wife believes he abandoned her ten years ago.

leverage.vulnerability: His love for Millona Umbranox and fear of dying as an forgotten phantom.
leverage.bribe: Heist tools, boots of Springheel Jak, and arrow of extrication.

dialogueHooks: Voice Tell: "Playful, aristocratic rogue cadence masking deep melancholy and desperation."
Crucible Reaction: "Leaps across palace rafters with supernatural acrobatics to secure the Elder Scroll."
npcs.notes: **Character & Station:** The Gray Fox (`character_gray_fox`), cursed bearer of the Gray Cowl of Nocturnal.

npcs.name: Arch-Mage Hannibal Traven
npcs.motivation: Protect the Arcane University from Mannimarco's worm cult, even if it requires offering his own soul as the final black soul gem ward.

secretsKnown.secret: His total ban on necromancy split the Guild in two and drove dozens of talented conjurers directly into Mannimarco's waiting arms.

leverage.vulnerability: Guilt over driving young mages to necromancy.
leverage.bribe: Rare Ayleid texts and Welkynd stones.

dialogueHooks: Voice Tell: "Grave, scholastic authority, tired eyes burdened by institutional decay."
Crucible Reaction: "Places the colossal black soul gem on his altar and drinks deadly poison to seal Mannimarco's fate."
npcs.notes: **Character & Station:** Arch-Mage Hannibal Traven (`character_hannibal_traven`), tragic reformer of the Mages Guild.

npcs.name: Modryn Oreyn
npcs.motivation: Expose the Blackwood Company's corrupt mercenary monopoly and uncover the dark substance driving their bloodthirsty frenzies.

secretsKnown.secret: The Blackwood Company smuggled an inverted Hist Tree from Black Marsh into Leyawiin and pumps corrupted sap into their recruits.

leverage.vulnerability: His duty to Guildmaster Vilena Donton and the lives of his fellow mercenaries.
leverage.bribe: Proof of Blackwood Company atrocities.

dialogueHooks: Voice Tell: "Gruff Dunmer pragmatism, loves painting terrible portraits in his spare time, calls fools by their names."
Crucible Reaction: "Leads a direct assault on the Blackwood Company headquarters with two-handed steel."
npcs.notes: **Character & Station:** Modryn Oreyn (`character_modryn_oreyn`), stalwart second-in-command of the Fighters Guild.

npcs.name: Captain Savlian Matius
npcs.motivation: Hold the burning barricades of Kvatch, protect the surviving civilians trapped in the Chapel of Akatosh, and reclaim Castle Kvatch from the Daedra.

secretsKnown.secret: Count Ormellius Goldwine was killed inside the castle; Savlian is withholding the news to prevent the surviving guards from despairing.

leverage.vulnerability: The lives of Kvatch's refugees.
leverage.bribe: Direct tactical assault on the Oblivion Gate.

dialogueHooks: Voice Tell: "Hoarse shouting over the roar of flames, sword dented and shield scorched, unflinching Colovian grit."
Crucible Reaction: "Blows his signal horn and rallies the ragged guard into the courtyard breach."
npcs.notes: **Character & Station:** Captain Savlian Matius (`character_savlian_matius`), hero of the defense of Kvatch.

npcs.name: Emperor Uriel Septim VII
npcs.motivation: Accept his foretold death with dignity and pass the Amulet of Kings to the prisoner chosen by the stars.

secretsKnown.secret: The location of his illegitimate son Martin, hidden thirty years ago in the Chapel of Akatosh at Kvatch.

leverage.vulnerability: The survival of Tamriel.
leverage.bribe: None; accepts his martyrdom.

dialogueHooks: Voice Tell: "Ancient, resonant, sorrowful majesty; sees beyond the veil of time into the constellations of destiny."
Crucible Reaction: "Hands the Amulet of Kings to the player with his dying breath, charging them to find Jauffre."
npcs.notes: **Character & Station:** Emperor Uriel Septim VII (`character_uriel_septim`), 21st Emperor of the Septim Dynasty.

npcs.name: Ocheeva
npcs.motivation: Maintain familial harmony and discipline within the Sanctuary until the purification order comes from above.

secretsKnown.secret: She suspects Lucien Lachance's recent orders are erratic, but her Argonian shadowscale discipline forbids questioning the Speaker.

leverage.vulnerability: Her love for her Shadowscale brother Teinaava.
leverage.bribe: Ancient Shadowscale poisons and daggers.

dialogueHooks: Voice Tell: "Hissing maternal warmth coupled with cold reptilian calculation; treats fellow assassins as beloved hatchlings."
Crucible Reaction: "Draws her poisoned blade with tears in her eyes when attacked by her own brothers."
npcs.notes: **Character & Station:** Ocheeva (`character_ocheeva`), Shadowscale leader of the Cheydinhal Sanctuary.
npcs.faction: The Dark Brotherhood & The Black Hand

npcs.name: Vicente Valtieri
npcs.motivation: Provide steady contract guidance to new initiates while seeking victims to sustain his centuries-old vampiric thirst.

secretsKnown.secret: He was turned by a vampire patriarch in the Imperial City centuries ago and still remembers the Empire before the Septims.

leverage.vulnerability: Garlic (severe allergy) and silver weapons.
leverage.bribe: The gift of Vampirism (Dark Gift).

dialogueHooks: Voice Tell: "Polite, aristocratic whisper; pale skin and crimson eyes gleaming beneath his cowl."
Crucible Reaction: "Moves with blur-speed and drains attackers with vampiric touch."
npcs.notes: **Character & Station:** Vicente Valtieri (`character_vicente_valtieri`), ancient vampire of the Dark Brotherhood.
npcs.faction: The Dark Brotherhood & The Black Hand

npcs.name: Jeelius
npcs.motivation: Survive the bloody sacrificial altar of Lake Arrius and return to the Temple of the One in the Imperial City.

secretsKnown.secret: He overheard Mankar Camoran's secret password to the inner sanctum and memorized the layout of the Lake Arrius shrines.

leverage.vulnerability: Immediate threat of Daedric sacrifice.
leverage.bribe: Information on Camoran's ritual circle.

dialogueHooks: Voice Tell: "Trembling Argonian cadence, gasping for breath against binding chains on the altar stone."
Crucible Reaction: "Sprints through the cavern tunnels toward daylight the instant his bonds are severed."
npcs.notes: **Character & Station:** Jeelius (`character_jeelius`), Argonian temple priest held hostage by the Mythic Dawn.

npcs.name: Marshal Isaura Venn
npcs.role: Field Marshal of the Blackwood Company
npcs.motivation: Secure lucrative county security contracts by any means necessary, using Hist sap to eliminate fear and conscience in her troops.

secretsKnown.secret: The Hist sap harvested in Leyawiin induces violent psychotic hallucinations that cause mercenaries to butcher innocent villagers believing they are goblins.

leverage.vulnerability: Physical addiction and mental degradation from prolonged Hist sap ingestion.
leverage.bribe: Gold, imperial contracts, or exotic Black Marsh flora.

dialogueHooks: Voice Tell: "Harsh military cadence, slurs slightly from nightly sap doses, eyes tinged with yellow Hist haze."
Crucible Reaction: "Swallows a whole vial of sap and enters a berserk frenzy, swinging a massive claymore."
npcs.notes: **Character & Station:** Marshal Isaura Venn (`character_blackwood_commander`), ruthless commander of the Blackwood Company.

npcs.name: Krazz-Nur, Kvatch Dremora Champion
npcs.role: Citadel Warden of the Kvatch Sigil Tower
npcs.motivation: Crush mortal resistance at the first breach and defend the Sigil Stone anchoring the gateway between Mundus and the Deadlands.

secretsKnown.secret: Removing the Sigil Stone immediately collapses the spatial conduit and banishes all occupying Daedra back to the waters of Oblivion.

leverage.vulnerability: Daedric pride and disdain for mortal cunning.
leverage.bribe: None; fights to the death in honorable martial combat.

dialogueHooks: Voice Tell: "Guttural, metallic Daedric boom: 'Mortal worms, you throw your lives into Dagon's furnace!'"
Crucible Reaction: "Summons flame atronachs and strikes with a burning greatsword until cleaved in two."
npcs.notes: **Character & Station:** Krazz-Nur (`character_dremora_commander`), Dremora Markynaz guarding the Kvatch Sigil Keep.

npcs.name: Carius Runellius
npcs.motivation: Carius starts out inside the Lirrians' house, and patrols the area 24 hours a day.

psychologicalProfile.externalWant: Carius starts out inside the Lirrians' house, and patrols the area 24 hours a day.
psychologicalProfile.deepNeed: Preserve personal honor and local sanctuary amidst the Oblivion Crisis.
psychologicalProfile.primalWound: Haunted by regional instability and the sudden collapse of imperial authority.

secretsKnown.secret: Possesses confidential knowledge regarding Carius Runellius's private savings, trade associations, and personal habits in Bruma.

leverage.vulnerability: Vulnerable to threats targeting their standing as Carius Runellius among the Bruma community and their Guard livelihood.
leverage.bribe: Tempered steel weaponry, enchanted arrows, and official legion commendations.

dialogueHooks: Voice Tell: "Carius Runellius speaks with the distinct cadence of a Imperial Guard established in Bruma."
Crucible Reaction: "Stands firm to protect their station in Bruma, refusing to abandon duty even under Daedric threat."

quests.name: A Brotherhood Betrayed
quests.title: A Brotherhood Betrayed
quests.description: It appears that a Bradon Lirrian
quests.notes:
It appears that a Bradon Lirrian

**Canonical Outcome:**
There is a rumor in Bruma about Raynil Dralas, who claims that he is a vampire hunter. You also learn that he has already killed an alleged vampire in town, a local man named Bradon Lirrian.

1. Learn from townspeople about rumors of a vampire killing.
2. Persuade a local investigator and widow to talk to you about the murder of the supposed vampire.
3. Ask around about the whereabouts of the vampire hunter, Raynil Dralas. Many point to Olav's Tap and Tack.
4. After attempting futilely to speak to Dralas, talk to Olav to be given a key to Dralas' room, where you find his diary.
5. Give the diary to Carius, who points you toward Boreal Stone Cave. Travel there quickly, as you only have one day to finish the quest.
6. Kill Raynil, and take his keys to recover the Mundane Amulet from the waterlogged chest.
7. Take the amulet back to Erline to reveal its true nature; you may keep the amulet as your reward.

**What-If Crucible:**
Raynil Dralas posed as a vampire hunter to murder Bradon Lirrian and steal the Mundane Amulet. (A) Hunt down Raynil at Boreal Stone Cave, execute him, and return the amulet to Erline: clears Bradon's name and uncovers the true magical Phylactery of Litheness. (B) Demand Raynil hand over his co-conspirators' plunder before slaying him: extracts hidden treasure caches in Bruma at the expense of delayed justice. (C) Keep the Mundane Amulet without revealing its secret enchantment to Erline: exploits a grieving widow to retain an enchanted ward.

quests.name: A Brush with Death
quests.title: A Brush with Death
quests.description: Help a distraught Tivela Lythandas
quests.notes:
Help a distraught Tivela Lythandas

**Canonical Outcome:**
If you ask around town in Cheydinhal, people will tell you that Rythe Lythandas, a famous painter, has gone missing, and his wife, Tivela, is very upset. Go to the Lythandas house on the south side of town, and talk to Tivela for more information. Tivela tells you that Rythe had locked himself in his study, as he often did. However, after not seeing him for several days, Tivela decided to investigate. Upon doing so, she discovers that Rythe has disappeared.

1. Listen to rumors in Cheydinhal about the missing painter, and meet his wife, Tivela, in their house.
2. Tivela tells you about her husband locking himself in his room; go to his room, and enter the painting.
3. Find Rythe and he tells you about a thief who stole his magic paintbrush.
4. Find the thief's corpse and retrieve the paintbrush.
5. Return to Rythe with the brush and you will both return to Tamriel. He will reward you with the Apron of Adroitness.

**What-If Crucible:**
Painter Rythe Lythandas is trapped inside his magical Painted World by a rogue thief wielding painted trolls. (A) Enter the canvas, slay the painted trolls using turpentine, retrieve the magic brush, and paint an exit: saves Rythe and receives the enchanted Apron of Adroitness. (B) Study the metaphysical properties of the magic paintbrush: learns reality-altering illusion painting before returning Rythe to Cheydinhal. (C) Leave Rythe in the canvas temporarily to explore the painted realm: plunders the whimsical dreamscape, risking permanent entrapment.

**Canonical Outcome:**
Defeat the Wrath_of_Sithis#Wrath_of_Sithis

**What-If Crucible:**
Sithis sends the Wrath of Sithis to reclaim your soul after breaking the Tenets. (A) Slay the apparition in brutal single combat: purges your dishonor in the eyes of the Dark Brotherhood, but scars your soul with an eternal chill. (B) Banish the phantom using consecration rites: defies Sithis's supernatural reach, severing your dark gift and turning the Sanctuary permanently hostile. (C) Surrender a portion of your life force or a willing retainer in appeasement: avoids mortal combat at the expense of an innocent ally's damnation.

quests.description: You must prove your worthiness to join the Dark Brotherhood
quests.notes:
You must prove your worthiness to join the Dark Brotherhood

**Canonical Outcome:**
You may overhear a rumor spreading in Cyrodiil about the recruitment of the group of assassins known as the Dark Brotherhood: "They say that when you murder someone, the Dark Brotherhood comes to you in your sleep. It's how they recruit new members." This means that in order to become recruited by the Brotherhood, you must murder an innocent in cold blood. Once you have completed that, the cryptic message "Your killing has been observed by forces unknown..." will appear in the corner of your screen, indicating that the next time you sleep in any given location, you will be visited by a member of the Dark Brotherhood. For suggestions on potential targets to murder, see this page.

1. Once you've murdered an innocent, sleep in any bed in Cyrodiil (see bugs).
2. Receive a visit from Lucien Lachance.
3. Travel to the Inn of Ill Omen, south of the Imperial City.
4. *(Optional) Speak with Manheim Maulhand about Rufio.
5. Confront Rufio and kill him; then sleep again in any bed.
6. Receive another visit from Lucien and join the Dark Brotherhood.
7. Travel to Cheydinhal and enter the abandoned house.
8. Speak the passphrase and enter the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary.
9. Speak with Ocheeva and receive the armor of the Brotherhood.
10. Speak with Vicente Valtieri about your first contract.

**What-If Crucible:**
Lucien Lachance tasks you with executing Rufio at the Inn of Ill Omen as your initiation. (A) Execute the frail, terrified Rufio in his sleep: fulfills the test ruthlessly and secures induction into the Cheydinhal Sanctuary without incident. (B) Interrogate Rufio about his past victim: learns the wretched crime that placed the Black Sacrament upon his head before delivering cold justice. (C) Spare Rufio and stage his demise: defies the Dark Brotherhood at inception, earning Lucien Lachance's immediate nocturnal retribution.

quests.name: A Mage's Staff
quests.title: A Mage's Staff
quests.description: Complete your induction into the Mages Guild
quests.notes:
Complete your induction into the Mages Guild

**Canonical Outcome:**
After you have received all recommendations, travel to the Arcane University and speak to Raminus Polus. He will be in the Arch-Mage's Lobby during the daytime. At night, he will be unavailable to you. Once you are accepted into the guild by Raminus, speak to him about tasks to be told about the construction of your Mage's Staff. First you need to retrieve some special wood for the staff from Wellspring Cave, east of the Imperial City.

1. Speak with Raminus Polus about the Arcane University. Once accepted, your task is to have a personal Staff made.
2. Travel to Wellspring Cave only to discover there is a problem with the mages who guard this sacred place.
3. Make your way through the cave, taking care of (or avoiding) any enemies you encounter.
4. On the farside of Wellspring Cave dispose of the necromancers lying in wait.
5. Take the wood from the chest and return to Raminus, who instructs you to go see Delmar in the Chironasium.
6. Delmar asks you to choose the type of enchantment you would like and requests a full day's time to finish the work.
7. Return after a day has passed and Delmar will tell you to retrieve your custom staff from the cupboard in the back.
8. After you have your staff go see Raminus to be promoted to Journeyman.

**What-If Crucible:**
Necromancers have slaughtered the mages at Wellspring Cave to seize enchanted staff-wood. (A) Slay the necromancer infiltrators and carve your custom staff: secures your official Mage's Staff from Delmar and earns promotion to Journeyman. (B) Study the corrupted dark sap residue left in the wellspring: gains rare insights into Worm Cult enchantment at the risk of Delmar detecting tainted wood. (C) Pursue the fleeing necromancer couriers into the surrounding forest: intercepts intercepted communication intended for Mannimarco before reporting back to Traven.

You are to travel to Bruma and speak to Jeanne Frasoric there. He hasn't heard anything from her in a few days, and while he appreciates a break from her constant messages and questions, he is worried that this behavior isn't like her.

1. Speak to Traven a few days after completing Information at a Price. He wants you to check up on the Bruma Mages Guild.
2. Head to Bruma and go straight to the Mages Guild. The guild hall will be in flames once you enter.
3. Fight your way through the ruins until you find Camilla Lollia. Kill her.

5. Return to the Arcane University to report to Traven.

(A) Slay the necromancer Camilla Lollia and escort traumatized J'skar to the Imperial City: delivers crucial eyewitness intelligence regarding Mannimarco's return to Arch-Mage Traven. (B) Search the charred remnants of the guild library for Jeanne Frasoric's missing ledger: uncovers evidence of internal guild negligence and leaks before fleeing the blaze. (C) Track the necromancer strike force's retreat toward Echo Cave: risks an ambush to delay their convergence on other guild halls.

1. Speak with Azzan; he claims to have a job that's perfect for you.
2. Head over to Arvena's house and ask her about her rat problem.
3. Go down to the basement to discover and kill the culprit. Afterwards, head back to Arvena and speak with her again.
4. Find Pinarus Inventius and go hunting.
5. Return once again to Arvena to find your excursion wasn't very successful in solving her problem.
6. Follow Arvena's unknowing suspect around Anvil, watching for suspicious activity.
7. Once you catch the person responsible, make a decision that will determine what reward you receive.

**What-If Crucible:**
Arvena Thelas in Anvil complains that mountain lions are infiltrating her basement and killing her pet rats. (A) Stake out the basement, track the lions to Quill-Weave's yard, and uncover her rotten meat bait: exposes Quill-Weave's petty feud peacefully while saving Arvena's surviving rats. (B) Slay Quill-Weave on the spot for endangering domestic residents: enforces brutal mercenary justice but shocks the Anvil community. (C) Extort hush money from Quill-Weave while claiming the full bounty from Arvena: maximizes personal coin from both sides of the domestic squabble.

quests.name: A Ring of Keys
quests.title: A Ring of Keys
quests.description: A treasure hunt in Pale_Pass
quests.notes:
A treasure hunt in Pale_Pass

**Canonical Outcome:**
While on the quest Lifting the Vale, you will go through the Serpent's Trail to Pale Pass and follow the path to the ruined fort. Once you reach the ruined fort, you're ready to find the treasure.

1. Note: This quest does not appear in your journal. You must start Lifting the Vale quest before Pale Pass even shows up on your map.
2. Find four containers in order near the fort in Pale Pass.
3. A key found in each one allows you to open the next.
4. In the last container is the Circlet of Omnipotence which grants +3 Fortify each to Agility, Endurance, Speed, Strength, and Willpower.

**What-If Crucible:**
A complex subterranean network of locked gates beneath Chorrol holds forgotten heirloom caches. (A) Recover all ancient skeleton keys through meticulous lockpicking and crypt exploration: unlocks the city's hidden reserve vaults. (B) Use sonic blast spells to shatter the iron gates: breaches the vaults rapidly, alerting city guards to the underground detonation. (C) Sell the key ring to the Thieves Guild: trades historical access for underworld fence favor.

1. Talk to Dar-Ma in Chorrol.
2. Leave and return to Chorrol.
3. A few days later, visit her mother, Seed-Neeus, to learn that she has not returned from a trip to Hackdirt.

**What-If Crucible:**
Dar-Ma has been kidnapped by the sinister, xenophobic subterranean cult of Hackdirt worshipping 'The Deep Ones'. (A) Infiltrate Hackdirt's chapel and cavern labyrinth, rescue Dar-Ma from the altar, and escort her to Chorrol: reunites mother and daughter, earning free merchant training. (B) Burn Hackdirt and purge its mutated 'Brethren' to the ground: destroys the Deep Ones cult permanently, avenging vanished travelers. (C) Commune with the subterranean Deep Ones beneath the altar: glimpses ancient eldritch entities at the cost of sanity.

**Canonical Outcome:**
1. Speak with Vicente Valtieri for your first contract.
2. Go to the Waterfront District and sneak onto the Marie Elena.
3. Make your way up to the Captain's Cabin.
4. Once the Captain is dead, dispatch or flee from the ship's pirates.

**What-If Crucible:**
Captain Gaston Tussaud must be eliminated aboard the Marie Elena in the Imperial City Waterfront. (A) Infiltrate through the lower cargo hold and assassinate Tussaud in his cabin: claims the contract and captain's key while evading the pirate crew. (B) Incite a mutiny among the crew on deck: turns the pirate deckhands against their captain, causing chaos that draws Captain Lex's Watchmen into Waterfront bloodshed. (C) Bribe Tussaud into faking his murder and abandoning Cyrodiil: spares the smuggler for future illicit maritime contraband, risking Brotherhood retribution.

quests.name: Acrobatics Training
quests.title: Acrobatics Training
quests.description: Tread the difficult path to find an Torbern
quests.notes:
Tread the difficult path to find an Torbern

**Canonical Outcome:**
Once your Acrobatics skill is 70 or higher, speak with either Ganredhel in the city of Cheydinhal or with Tsrava in Leyawiin to learn who can teach you more about Acrobatics. You will be told that Aerin is the only one that can do it and you are sent to find her at her camp. They helpfully mark the location on your map.

1. When your Acrobatics skill reaches 70, speak with Ganredhel in Cheydinhal or Tsrava in Leyawiin.
2. Once you have the recommendation, head to Aerin's Camp to speak with Aerin.
3. When you arrive you will find Torbern instead, who agrees to train you.

**What-If Crucible:**
Torbern at Aerin's Camp in the Jerall Mountains will only instruct true acrobats who prove their nimbleness. (A) Scale the sheer vertical cliffs and leap across the jagged glacial chasms of the Jeralls: impresses Torbern and unlocks master acrobatics, allowing water-jumping. (B) Use feather and levitation spells to simulate unnatural vertical leaps: earns the training through clever arcane trickery rather than physical conditioning. (C) Challenge Torbern to an acrobatic downhill race: tests your agility on treacherous scree slopes, risking fatal mountain falls.

quests.description: You are asked to bring in Bruma Allies
quests.notes:

**Canonical Outcome:**
Jauffre tells you that the Daedra are innumerable while the Bruma town guard are not. He therefore asks you to go and petition the other cities in Cyrodiil, the guilds and the Elder Council to send temporary relief troops to help close any Oblivion Gates that open around town.

1. This is an optional quest that can be done at any point after completing Bruma Gate and before starting Defense of Bruma. You can also partially complete it - i.e. get aid sent from some, but not all of the cities. Once you have completed the Defense of Bruma, Allies for Bruma will be automatically marked completed in your journal, even if you did not recruit everyone.
2. You are sent to request more troops for Captain Burd.
3. He tells you to petition the other cities, the guilds, and the Elder Council to send temporary relief troops to Bruma.
4. Go to each city and ask the count or countess of each for "Aid for Bruma".
5. After each city has provided aid, that city's troops will set up camp in Bruma.

**What-If Crucible:**
Jauffre asks you to rally garrison reinforcements from every Cyrodiil county to defend Bruma from the Great Gate. (A) Close the Oblivion Gates threatening all seven county capitals to secure full legions of aid: forges an unprecedented united provincial coalition for the battle of Bruma. (B) Focus on securing only the wealthiest counties (Imperial City, Skingrad, Cheydinhal): minimizes travel time and concentrates heavy elite armor, but leaves southern borders vulnerable. (C) Demand that counts send troops unconditionally under Imperial emergency decree: bullies provincial nobility, securing soldiers at the cost of deep regional resentment.

quests.title: An Unexpected Voyage
quests.description: The The Bloated Float Inn
quests.notes:
The The Bloated Float Inn

**Canonical Outcome:**
Go to The Bloated Float Inn in the Waterfront district of the Imperial City. Speak to Ormil, the publican, and rent a room for 10 gold. Head below the deck to your new room. Now you must sleep, but before doing so, move the pitcher to find a bag with some gems (see Notes section below). When you wake up, your journal will update to tell you that the Bloated Float has been put out to sea. Leave your room and you will immediately run into a bandit named Lynch. Talk to him (the correct options are the bottom of the two responses each time) to obtain some important quest-related information:

1. Sleep on The Bloated Float; you will awaken to find it hijacked.
2. Speak with Lynch about the gang now commandeering the inn and free the bouncer, Graman gro-Marad.
3. Speak with and kill Minx.
4. Speak with and kill Wrath to obtain his key.
5. Make your way to the cabin to find the leader of the gang.
6. Decide whether to kill her or negotiate with her. Negotiate successfully and she'll surrender herself and her sword; Ormil will apprehend her.
7. Rest again in your room: the ship will be back at the dock when you wake up.
8. Speak with Ormil about the gang to receive your reward in gold.

**What-If Crucible:**
While sleeping at the Bloated Float inn on the Waterfront, the ship is hijacked and steered out to sea by the Blackwater Bandits. (A) Subdue or slay Lynch, Minx, Wrath, and Ormil's traitor Selene: retakes the vessel bloodlessly where possible and docks back in the Imperial City. (B) Join forces with the Blackwater Bandits: turns pirate, sailing the Bloated Float into Niben Bay as a floating smuggler fortress. (C) Parley with Ormil and trick the bandits into surrendering their swords: proves cunning diplomacy over swordsmanship.

quests.name: Attack on Fort Sutch
quests.title: Attack on Fort Sutch
quests.description: Help a group of soldiers close an Oblivion_Gate
quests.notes:
Help a group of soldiers close an Oblivion_Gate

**Canonical Outcome:**
Unlike most quests, this does not show up in your journal. The trigger for this quest is the delivery of the Mysterium Xarxes to Martin (part of the Dagon Shrine quest) and the subsequent opening of several Oblivion Gates across Cyrodiil. This particular gate opens at Fort Sutch, which is also the site of a Dark Brotherhood quest, Bad Medicine.

1. Note: This quest does not appear in your journal.
2. At any time after completing Dagon Shrine, but before completing Light the Dragonfires, travel to Fort Sutch.
3. You will find a group of soldiers battling Daedra in front of an Oblivion Gate.
4. Help the soldiers defeat the Daedra.
5. Close the Oblivion Gate.

**What-If Crucible:**
Imperial Legion forces and Daedric invaders clash in an open assault outside the ruins of Fort Sutch. (A) Rally the Imperial Legion vanguard, breach the Daedric perimeter, and sever the Sigil Stone: secures Fort Sutch for the Empire. (B) Allow the Daedric shock troops and legionnaires to slaughter each other before claiming the ruin: loots both sides' corpses with zero personal risk. (C) Deploy mass area elemental bombardment: wipes out the entire warzone, obliterating Daedra and Legion alike.

quests.title: Azura
quests.description: Kill some former worshippers of Azura
quests.notes:
Kill some former worshippers of Azura

**Canonical Outcome:**
Azura's Shrine is located far north of Cheydinhal, north and slightly east of Lake Arrius Caverns, and high up in the Jerall Mountains. The shrine can be accessed using an unmarked road.

1. Once you have reached level 2, travel to the Shrine of Azura and speak to Mels Maryon.
2. Acquire one sample of Glow Dust to give as an offering to Azura.
3. Approach the Shrine of Azura and offer the Glow Dust at dusk (5-7pm) or dawn (5-7am).
4. Kill the former worshippers of Azura that are trapped inside of the Gutted Mine.
5. Return to the Shrine of Azura to receive your reward.

**What-If Crucible:**
Azura tasks you with granting merciful death to five of her followers who contracted vampirism in Gutted Mine. (A) Slay the five tragic vampires and place Azura's glowing rose at the altar: frees their souls from torment and receives Azura's Star, the infinite grand soul gem. (B) Seek an experimental cure for vampirism to save Azura's followers: defies the Prince's death sentence in a bid for redemption, risking Azura's wrath. (C) Trap the souls of the five vampires in standard black soul gems: exploits their tragic suffering for personal necromantic power, permanently desecrating Azura's shrine.

quests.title: Bad Medicine
quests.description: Cure the sickly warlord Roderick
quests.notes:
Cure the sickly warlord Roderick

**Canonical Outcome:**
Speak with Ocheeva to complete the "Enter the Eliminator" mini-quest and receive your next contract. She asks you to kill the ailing warlord Roderick at Fort Sutch and gives you a bottle of poisoned medicine. Only by sneaking into the fort and replacing his medicine bottle with the poisoned one, while remaining completely undetected, will you receive a bonus.

1. Receive the contract from Ocheeva and the new "medicine".
2. Travel to Fort Sutch and make your way to Roderick.
3. * (Optional) Remain undetected during the infiltration.
4. Switch the medicine with the poison in the cupboard.
5. Head back to the Cheydinhal Sanctuary to receive your reward.

**What-If Crucible:**
Roderick lies ill at Fort Sutch, guarded by loyal mercenaries, taking daily medicine. (A) Swap Roderick's medicine bottle with poisoned brew unnoticed: ensures a quiet, natural-looking demise and collects the bonus cleanly. (B) Slit Roderick's throat and butcher the mercenary garrison: leaves a gory calling card that puts Imperial authorities on high alert. (C) Inform the mercenary captain that someone put a contract on Roderick: triggers an internal panic, fracturing the warband while forfeiting Brotherhood standing.

quests.name: Bittneld and Emfrid
quests.title: Bittneld and Emfrid
quests.description: Help to bring two lonely hearts together (non-journal).
quests.notes:
Help to bring two lonely hearts together (non-journal).

**Canonical Outcome:**
Author Casta Scribonia is well known for her romantic stories, but turns out to be equally romantic in life. When asked about Chorrol, she will tell you about two lonely existences in town, a guard captain and the proprietor of the local inn. She thinks they would be a perfect match, but will never reveal their names. The captain of the Chorrol guard, Bittneld the Curse-Bringer, seems to enjoy his work but isn't so keen on the town's female population. Ask him about Chorrol and he will tell you that although he thinks the women are "fine-looking", he also thinks they're snooty and not very nice.

1. Note: The quest is fully functional in Oblivion Remastered only. In the original game, most of this quest is skipped, instead going straight from Bittneld complaining about the town's women to Emfrid thanking you for bringing them together. The Unofficial Oblivion Patch re-adds the other lines.
2. Note: This quest does not appear in your journal
3. Talk to a local author who wants to play matchmaker.
4. Talk to Bittneld the Curse-Bringer about himself and his town.
5. Talk to Emfrid about Bittneld.
6. Return to Bittneld with a suggestion.

**What-If Crucible:**
Bittneld, Chorrol's lonely captain of the guard, needs encouragement to notice Emfrid, the welcoming innkeeper of The Oak and Crosier. (A) Play matchmaker through heartfelt conversation, bringing Bittneld and Emfrid together: brings joy and warmth to Chorrol's tavern. (B) Advise Bittneld to focus solely on military discipline and guard patrols: sharpens town vigilance at the cost of domestic romance. (C) Spread malicious tavern gossip that Bittneld prefers tavern wenches in Skingrad: creates petty town drama for personal amusement.

quests.description: Tag along with Mazoga the Orc (person)
quests.notes:
Tag along with Mazoga the Orc (person)

**Canonical Outcome:**
After the Knights of the White Stallion quest, Mazoga spends most of her time in the White Stallion Lodge or nearby; however, three days a week she hunts for Black Bow Bandits, and she will invite you along. The Black Bows you collect can be taken to Count Marius Caro, who gives you 100 gold for each Black Bow you bring to him. When adventuring with Mazoga, note that she is not essential and may be killed at any time.

1. Note: This quest does not appear in your journal
2. After you have completed Knights of the White Stallion, find Mazoga the Orc and she'll invite you along with her to hunt for more Black Bow Bandits.
3. On Morndas, you can join Mazoga and clear the Ayleid ruin Telepe.
4. On Middas, you will wipe out Rockmilk Cave.
5. On Turdas, Undertow Cavern needs a spring cleaning.

**What-If Crucible:**
Count Marius Caro of Leyawiin pays a bounty for every Black Bow recovered from Mazoga's outlaw rivals. (A) Hunt down Black Bow bandits across Blackwood and turn in their bows to Count Caro: systematically cleanses the bandit plague and earns 100 gold per bow. (B) Sell the enchanted Black Bows on the underworld black market: yields higher profits while arming Waterfront cutpurses. (C) Uncover the Black Bows' secret supply line in Rockmilk Cave: strikes at the heart of their criminal leadership.

Martin Septim requires the blood of a Daedric Prince—contained in an authentic Daedric artifact—to open Mankar Camoran's portal. (A) Offer Azura's Star, Wabbajack, or the Skull of Corruption on the ritual anvil: destroys a wondrous metaphysical relic to advance the salvation of Tamriel. (B) Seek out the most malevolent artifact (Mehrunes' Razor or Ebony Blade) to destroy dark evil: purges a cursed relic from the mortal plane while empowering the Septim ritual. (C) Hesitate to sacrifice the relic and seek an alternative conduit: buys time to experiment with lesser Daedric hearts, delaying Martin's portal preparation.

quests.name: Blood of the Divines
quests.title: Blood of the Divines
quests.description: Recover the blood of a Nine Divines
quests.notes:
Recover the blood of a Nine Divines

**Canonical Outcome:**
Martin tells you the next ingredient to open the portal is the Blood of the Divines. Speak to Jauffre to learn that the blood of Tiber Septim (who became the god Talos) can probably be found on his armor in Sancre Tor. These catacombs were sealed by the first Grandmaster of the Blades and any who have tried to explore have never returned. Jauffre gives you a key to Sancre Tor and wishes you luck.

1. Talk to Martin and learn of the "blood of the gods".
2. Explore the catacombs of Sancre Tor to find and defeat the first Undead Blade to learn about a curse.
3. Defeat the three remaining undead Blades to free them of the curse.
4. Kill the undead Warden to access the rest of the tomb, and watch the Blade Ghosts dispel the evil enchantment.
5. Obtain the Armor of Tiber Septim and bring it back to Martin.

**What-If Crucible:**
Martin needs the dried blood of a Divine, found on the ancient Armor of Tiber Septim inside Sancre Tor. (A) Enter the haunted catacombs of Sancre Tor, free the four cursed Blade ghosts, and retrieve the holy armor: cleanses an ancient imperial tomb and earns the blessings of the Nine. (B) Absorb the divine essence lingering on the armor into your own blood: gains divine physical constitution before delivering the relic to Martin. **Canonical Outcome:**
After you have fenced 800 gold worth of stolen goods, Thieves Guild messenger Amusei actively seeks you out, reporting that the Gray Fox will be waiting for you at Ganredhel's house in Cheydinhal. The Gray Fox tells the tale of a famous thief, Springheel Jak, who died 300 years ago and was put to rest still wearing his enchanted boots. He then asks you to locate Jak's final resting place and retrieve the boots. The only known descendant of the famous thief is The Earl of Imbel, who goes by the name of Jakben and lives somewhere in the Imperial City. The Gray Fox finally tasks you to locate the Earl and search his house for clues.

1. Fence at least 800 gold to receive the quest from Amusei.
2. Talk to the Gray Fox for further details.
3. Locate Jakben, Earl of Imbel.
4. Uncover the truth about Springheel Jak.
5. Defeat Jakben and retrieve the Boots of Springheel Jak.

**What-If Crucible:**
The legendary Boots of Springheel Jak are owned by Jakben, Earl of Imbel, who is secretly a vampire noble. (A) Confront Jakben in his ancestral crypt, slay him in self-defense when he reveals his vampiric fangs, and take the boots: secures the boots for the Gray Fox without violating guild rules. (B) Bribe Jakben with fresh mortal thralls: trades innocent blood for the boots, avoiding combat while descending into criminal depravity. (C) Expose Jakben's vampiric identity to the Imperial Watch: lets the guards storm Imbel Manor while you snatch the boots during the raid.

quests.name: Breaking the Siege of Kvatch
quests.title: Breaking the Siege of Kvatch
quests.description: You must help defeat the Daedra
quests.notes:
You must help defeat the Daedra

**Canonical Outcome:**
As noted in Find the Heir, Martin will not escape with you unless everyone else in the Chapel of Akatosh can leave safely, but the guard will not let anyone out until Savlian Matius gives the order. Savlian is too busy killing the Daedra outside the Oblivion Gate to aid in your quest, so your only choice is to offer to help him close it. Tell him you want to help, get ready for battle, and activate the gate.

1. Talk to Savlian Matius.
2. Enter Oblivion. Head for the Blood Feast (the Sigil Keep) and make your way up.
3. Take the walkway to the Reapers Sprawl to find the prisoner. Kill his keeper to get the Sigil Keep Key.
4. Walk back to the Blood Feast, get to the top, and activate the Sigil Stone. The gate will close and you'll find yourself back in Kvatch.
5. Help Savlian clear out the Daedra in the plaza in front of the chapel so the survivors inside can be rescued.
6. Talk to Martin and tell him to follow you to Weynon Priory.

**What-If Crucible:**
Kvatch is engulfed in Daedric hellfire, and Savlian Matius needs a champion to enter the colossal Oblivion Gate. (A) Charge through the gate, climb the Sigil Keep, and sever the Sigil Stone from its magma cradle: collapses the gate, saves Kvatch survivors, and earns the title 'Hero of Kvatch'. (B) Rally the city guards into a defensive perimeter outside while you breach the gate alone: minimizes mortal casualties at the cost of facing Dremora lords in solo combat. (C) Loot the Daedric spires for rare Sigil Stones and dark armor before closing the portal: amasses incredible magical wealth while Kvatch's Chapel of Akatosh hangs by a thread.

1. Talk to Shum gro-Yarug.

(A) Purchase Rosethorn Hall and hire Eyja as your maid: claims the pinnacle of luxury, prestige, and privacy in Cyrodiil. (B) Uncover the hidden attic secret of the Rosethorn cache: solves the manor's architectural riddle to claim forgotten gems. (C) Host extravagant wine-tasting banquets for Count Hassildor: integrates into Skingrad's vampire aristocracy.

quests.name: Clavicus Vile
quests.title: Clavicus Vile
quests.description: Retrieve the infamous sword Umbra (sword)
quests.notes:
Retrieve the infamous sword Umbra (sword)

**Canonical Outcome:**
The shrine is located in the West Weald, a bit off the east of the Gold Road as it travels south, near Lake Rumare, and between Fort Virtue and the Ayleid ruin, Ceyatatar. You must find the shrine on your own; no one will tell you where it is.

1. Present Clavicus Vile with 500 gold once you reach level 20.
2. Clavicus will tell you that he wants the sword containing the soul of the warrior Umbra.
3. Retrieve the Umbra sword from the Bosmer, Umbra, located in the Ayleid ruin Vindasel.
4. Note: Umbra may be killed, and the sword retrieved, at any level, and even before initiating the quest. Once Umbra is dead and the sword is in your possession, speak with Ma'Raska to initiate the quest, then approach the shrine of Clavicus Vile.
5. Return to the shrine for your reward, the Masque of Clavicus Vile. Alternatively, you can refuse to give Umbra to Clavicus Vile, and you get to keep the sword as your reward.

**What-If Crucible:**
Clavicus Vile wants the soul-stealing sword Umbra, but his hound Barbas begs you not to deliver it. (A) Slay Umbra in Vindasel and return the cursed sword to Clavicus Vile: receives the Masque of Clavicus Vile and restores the Prince's full power. (B) Heed Barbas's desperate warning, keep the sword Umbra, and walk away: retains Tamriel's deadliest soul-trapping longsword while spurning the Prince of Bargains. (C) Redeem Lenwin (Umbra) by using restoration magic to break the sword's psychic grip: frees the warrior's soul from the blade's curse.

After exiting the sewers, your first task is to deliver the Amulet of Kings to Jauffre, the Grandmaster of the Blades. He resides at Weynon Priory, immediately south of Chorrol. **What-If Crucible:**
Following Emperor Uriel Septim VII's assassination, you must deliver the Amulet of Kings to Jauffre at Weynon Priory. (A) Travel swiftly across the Great Forest and deliver the Amulet directly into Jauffre's hands: secures the imperial heirloom and alerts the Grandmaster of the Blades without delay. (B) Seek audience with High Chancellor Ocato in the Imperial Palace first: informs the Elder Council of the Emperor's demise, navigating imperial political panic. (C) Attempt to wear the Amulet of Kings yourself: confirms that non-Dragonborn cannot wear the relic, reinforcing the divine prophecy.

**Canonical Outcome:**
You can receive this contract from Azzan in the Anvil Fighters Guild after you've done a few jobs for Modryn Oreyn in Chorrol. He'll ask you to look for a den of thieves that has been responsible for a recent spate of thefts in the area, referencing your past contract to help Norbert Lelles: "Good to see you're working hard. I've got some more thieves for you to deal with in Anvil. There have been a number of thefts in the area, and witnesses believe the thieves are holed up nearby. Check around, and see what you can learn." Azzan pairs you up for this mission with Maglir, whom you met recently on a past contract: "I'm not sure the numbers you'll be dealing with, so I'm sending you with another new recruit. Maglir. I believe you two have already met."

A gang of thieves is terrorizing Anvil, and Azzan pairs you with the disgruntled, unreliable Maglir to track them down. (A) Sweep Hrota Cave, eliminate the thief ring, and cover for Maglir's cowardice in your report: maintains guild cohesion and secures Azzan's respect. (B) Report Maglir's laziness and failure to engage directly to Azzan: initiates the disciplinary disciplinary spiral that drives Maglir into the Blackwood Company. (C) Cut a secret deal with the thieves' leader: takes a portion of their stolen plunder to steer guild patrols away from Hrota Cave.
