quests.name: Following a Lead
quests.title: Following a Lead
quests.description: What have you been doing, puppet?
quests.notes:
What have you been doing, puppet?

**Canonical Outcome:**
Once you kill Ungolim, Lucien Lachance will run up to you in a rage and demand to know what you've been doing. He says you have betrayed the Brotherhood and must die for it -- but seeing the confusion in your eyes, he reluctantly concedes that you were not involved and tells you that your last few dead drops were not picked up. At some point the real traitor, the puppeteer of this murderous scheme, must have started replacing your dead drops with their own. He lets you know that you have been unknowingly and systematically killing all the other members of the Black Hand. J'Ghasta, Shaleez, Alval Uvani, and Havilstein Hoar-Blood were all Speakers and Silencers, and Ungolim was the Listener. He tells you that the surviving Black Hand members are hunting him because they believe he is the traitor. He tells you to go to Anvil and wait by the site of the next dead drop to find out who the traitor is.

1. As soon as you complete the previous dead drop mission, a furious Lucien Lachance appears and explains the very serious rift that's been unknowingly set in motion.
2. You are to travel to Anvil and uncover the root of the plot you have unwittingly assisted.
3. Wait near the next dead drop until the courier comes, reveal yourself and demand the answers you deserve.
4. Once you've been "slightly" more informed about the situation, head over to the lighthouse and speak with the lighthouse keeper to acquire the key to the cellar.
5. Make your way outside around back to the cellar.
6. Once inside you are treated to a non-living, breathing nightmare; search for clues and uncover the truth about this morbid plot.
7. Meet up with Lucien at Applewatch - you find him... "accompanied" by the remainder of the Black Hand.
8. Wait until a certain time and speak with Arquen to complete the quest and automatically start the final quest in the Dark Brotherhood quest series, Honor Thy Mother.

**What-If Crucible:**
You discover the dead drops have been swapped to orchestrate the murder of the Black Hand. (A) Stake out the next drop in Anvil and trail Enilroth: uncovers Mathieu Bellamont's trail to Applewatch and rushes to save Lucien Lachance. (B) Report the dead drop tampering immediately to the remaining Black Hand: faces skepticism from Arquen and risks being branded a traitor yourself. (C) Execute Enilroth to tie up loose ends: prevents Bellamont from learning he was discovered, but loses critical testimony proving Lucien's innocence.

quests.name: Great Gate
quests.title: Great Gate
quests.description: Find the Great_Sigil_Stone
quests.notes:
Find the Great_Sigil_Stone

**Canonical Outcome:**
[Remaster Image: File:OB-creature-Siege Crawler.png; OBR-quest-Great Gate 02.jpg; The Siege Crawler advancing towards the Great Gate; right] As soon as you step through the Great Gate, you will be given 15 minutes (real time) to complete this quest. Any longer and the indestructible Daedric Siege Engine will make it to Tamriel, resulting in Martin's death and the invasion of all Tamriel by Daedra. At that point, the game is over: you must reload an earlier save game. This quest can also be terminated if Martin dies while you are in the Great Gate Oblivion World (although the combat in Tamriel actually pauses while you are in there, so Martin can only die if he receives a fatal blow just as you step into the Gate).

1. You have 15 minutes to complete this quest.
2. Enter the Great Gate and make your way to the World Breaker (the main tower).
3. Ascend the World Breaker tower to the Sigillum Sanguis.
4. Take the Great Sigil Stone to close the gate.
5. Return the stone to Martin.

**What-If Crucible:**
The colossal Great Gate has opened at Bruma, and a massive Daedric Siege Crawler threatens to crush the city in 15 minutes. (A) Race through the sprawling fiery citadels of Oblivion, reach the Sigil Tower apex, and extract the Great Sigil Stone just in time: destroys the Siege Crawler and saves Bruma from annihilation. (B) Stop to systematically destroy the Daedric support generators inside the gate: weakens the gateway permanently, but cuts the timer dangerously close. (C) Claim the Great Sigil Stone and channel its cosmic power into your own equipment: unlocks supreme enchanting potential before sealing the gate.

(A) Strike down Bellamont before the Night Mother's sarcophagus: avenges Lucien Lachance, secures the title of Listener, and earns the Blade of Woe's awakening. (B) Shield Arquen from Bellamont's initial onslaught: prevents the loss of another Speaker at the cost of absorbing devastating necrotic spells. (C) Question the Night Mother on why she permitted the purge of her children: extracts chilling eldritch truth about cosmic indifference at the risk of divine censure.

(B) Commission lightweight golden elven barding: maximizes speed and agility for cross-country scouting. (C) Test the horse armor's durability against mountain bandit arrows: confirms metallurgical resilience on the road.

(C) Accept a bribe to grant the smugglers safe passage through Leyawiin: opens an ongoing illicit revenue stream.

quests.name: Imperial Corruption
quests.title: Imperial Corruption
quests.description: One of the Audens Avidius
quests.notes:
One of the Audens Avidius

**Canonical Outcome:**
Talk to Luronk gro-Glurzog or his friend Ruslan, who both usually hang around in the Temple District, and they will complain about being robbed by some Imperial watchman while shopping at Jensine's "Good as New" Merchandise. Go to the shop in the Market District and talk to Jensine. If you raise her disposition to 70 she'll tell you the name of the soldier responsible - Audens Avidius.

1. Hear complaints of a crooked Imperial Watch Captain.
2. Speak with the shop owner where this occurred and find out who's behind it.
3. Report this to numerous guards and be directed to Itius Hayn.
4. Find two witnesses and convince them to testify against the corrupt Watch Captain - Audens Avidius.
5. After ten days, provided you are over level 5, Audens will find and attack you.
6. Kill him and search his corpse for a note.

**What-If Crucible:**
Captain Audens Avidius is extorting merchants in the Imperial City, and Jensine seeks a brave soul to report him. (A) Convince two shopkeepers to testify and report Avidius to Captain Servatius Quintilius or Garrus Darelliun: sees Avidius stripped of his rank and jailed. (B) Slay Avidius in a dark alley: removes the corrupt watch captain immediately, bypassing the sluggish legal bureaucracy. (C) Warn Avidius of the merchants' complaint: earns the corrupt captain's protection in the market district.

quests.title: Imperial Dragon Armor
quests.description: Receive your Imperial_Dragon_Cuirass
quests.notes:
Receive your Imperial_Dragon_Cuirass

**Canonical Outcome:**
After the cinematic of defeating Mehrunes Dagon finishes, Ocato rushes in and realizes what has transpired. Although he is concerned over what will become of the Empire, he is grateful that (almost) everyone survived and names you the Champion of Cyrodiil, a title only six other heroes have received in the history of the Empire. Ocato orders a suit of Imperial Dragon Armor for you, which is normally only worn by the Emperor, and says the armor will be ready in two weeks.

1. Talk to Ocato.
2. Wait two weeks.
3. Go to the Imperial Legion Armory in the Prison District.
4. Pick up your reward, a suit of Imperial Dragon Armor.

**What-If Crucible:**
Following Martin's sacrifice, High Chancellor Ocato orders the Imperial Armorer to forge your legendary Imperial Dragon Armor. (A) Commission the classical heavy Imperial Dragon Cuirass: symbolizes unbreakable martial loyalty to the Empire and crowns you Champion of Cyrodiil. (B) Request a customized lightweight variant optimized for stealth and skirmishing: adapts imperial regalia for a shadow operative rather than a front-line soldier. (C) Dedicate the ceremonial armor to Martin Septim's memory in the Temple of the One: inspires a wave of religious and imperial reverence across all nine counties.

quests.name: Independent Thievery
quests.title: Independent Thievery
quests.description: Steal as much as you can, and sell it to a Thieves Guild fence.
quests.notes:
Steal as much as you can, and sell it to a Thieves Guild fence.

**Canonical Outcome:**
This is an ongoing quest, triggered immediately after completing May the Best Thief Win, your initiation into the Thieves Guild. The sole purpose of the quest is to keep track of the amount of stolen goods you have fenced, as each and every 'special job', starting with Untaxing the Poor, requires a particular amount of fenced gold to become available. See quest section for requirements.

You will gain access to fences in a set order as you progress in rank within the Thieves Guild by completing the 'special jobs' offered to you by your Doyen. If you are not a member of the Thieves Guild, and select the barter option with a fence, they will claim that they do not know what you are talking about, and will not buy, or sell items. You can still invest in their shops though.

Fence !! Location !! Gold !! Mercantile !! Rank Required

**What-If Crucible:**
To advance through guild ranks, you must fence escalating amounts of stolen plunder to underworld fences. (A) Target opulent noble manors in the Elven Gardens and Talos Plaza: fences high-value jewels and silverware without harming common folk. (B) Plunder provincial shops and rural trading posts: builds fencing totals quickly through bulk goods, straining provincial economies. (C) Fence stolen Church silver and chapel relics: earns rapid gold while incurring the spiritual ire of the Nine Divines.

quests.name: Infiltration
quests.title: Infiltration
quests.description: Deceive your way into the Blackwood Company
quests.notes:
Deceive your way into the Blackwood Company

**Canonical Outcome:**
After Ajum-Kajin dies at Modryn Oreyn's house in Chorrol, Modryn tells you the next step is to infiltrate the Blackwood Company and its ranks so you can discover the secret of their strength.

1. Talk to Modryn Oreyn in his house in Chorrol to receive this quest.
2. Speak with Jeetum-Ze at the Blackwood Company Hall in Leyawiin to join their ranks.
3. Drink the Hist Sap and kill the "goblins" that have "invaded" Water's Edge.
4. Follow Modryn Oreyn's orders and speak with Marcel Amelion in Water's Edge to investigate the state of the town.
5. Return to Modryn Oreyn to complete the quest.

**What-If Crucible:**
Modryn Oreyn orders you to infiltrate the Blackwood Company's Leyawiin headquarters to discover the secret of their combat prowess. (A) Enlist as a recruit, consume their psychoactive Hist sap concoction, and witness the hallucinatory frenzy: uncovers the horrific source of their combat rage. (B) Steal the recipe and ledger from Ja'Fazir's desk without drinking the sap: avoids mental contamination while bringing documentary proof back to Modryn. (C) Embrace the Hist sap's feral strength: channels the ancient Argonian battle frenzy to slaughter Blackwood instructors from within.

quests.name: Information at a Price
quests.title: Information at a Price
quests.description: Once you have been promoted to Warlock, speak to Traven for your next task. Count Hassildor of Skingrad has personally requested that you go see him to retrieve some vital information regarding the necromancers. Traven stresses that the good relationship between Hassildor and the guild must be maintained. Travel to the Castle Skingrad and arrange an appointment with the Count's new assistant, Hal-Liurz, in the County Hall. She says that he has been expecting you and will tell him of your arrival immediately, unless you have done the Vampire Cure quest and encountered the bug where Hal-Liurz gets stuck in the Chamber of the Lost, in which case you will have to go and find the Count on your own. If not, wait for her to return with the Count. If she doesn't return soon, and your compass indicates that she's traveling towards Kvatch, go to the map marker. The Count will be there, and you can continue with the quest.

(C) Blackmail Count Hassildor regarding his own vampiric nature: extorts vast gold and arcane secrets from the Count, risking his immense wrath.

quests.description: Make your way to Chorrol and visit your old friend Modryn Oreyn. By now, the Blackwood Company is getting out of hand, and they must be brought down for the good of the Fighters Guild and the general public. Unfortunately, it's hard to tell where to start or what the source of their power is. Modryn tells you that a high-ranking member is currently holed up in the nearby Glademist Cave and that kidnapping him could yield valuable information. As this particular Argonian is very high up the chain of command and well guarded, however, he will make a difficult target.

By now, the Blackwood Company is getting out of hand, and they must be brought down for the good of the Fighters Guild and the general public. Unfortunately, it's hard to tell where to start or what the source of their power is. 1. Travel to Chorrol to visit Modryn Oreyn.
2. He will send you to Glademist Cave to capture Ajum-Kajin.
3. Work your way through the caves, defeating members of Blackwood as you go.
4. When you reach Ajum-Kajin, talk to him and he will agree to follow you back to Modryn.
5. Return to Modryn's house and speak with him. You must do whatever is necessary to make Ajum-Kajin talk.
6. Ajum-Kajin will answer the first two questions, but will kill himself rather than answer the third.
7. Talk to Modryn Oreyn again. He will give you an Amulet of Interrogation as your reward.

**What-If Crucible:**
Modryn Oreyn captures Ajum-Kaji, a Blackwood Company leader, and needs him interrogated regarding their leadership structure. (A) Interrogate Ajum-Kaji using verbal intimidation and magical threats: extracts details about Ri'Zakar and the Hist before Ajum-Kaji swallows lethal Blackwood poison. (B) Hand Ajum-Kaji over to the Leyawiin Imperial Guard: avoids illicit interrogation torture, but allows the Blackwood Company to bribe guards for his release. (C) Offer Ajum-Kaji asylum in Morrowind in exchange for the Hist extraction blueprint: seeks a bloodless resolution before his fanatical suicide.

quests.name: Join the Mages Guild
quests.title: Join the Mages Guild
quests.description: In order to join the Mages Guild, seek out a local head of the Mages Guild in any of Cyrodiil's seven guild halls. There is one in each city except for the Imperial City and Kvatch. All you need to do is ask to join the guild; as long as you have a clean criminal record you will be made part of the guild. You will be given a copy of the Mages Guild Charter and a Mages Guild Key that opens most of the doors in the seven guild halls. You are also now free to take almost all of the items you find in the guild halls and sell them for quick cash (there are still however a few privately owned items that cannot be freely taken, so pay attention to your icon before picking something up).

(C) Study the unique regional magical specialties of each city hall along the way: deepens your understanding of elemental and mystical arts before facing the Council.

quests.notes:

**Canonical Outcome:**
After reuniting Guilbert and Reynald Jemane in Separated at Birth, talking to Guilbert reveals the quest to help them reclaim their childhood home of Weatherleah. They say that their family was run off one day by Ogres, hence the separation. Guilbert will give conflicting directions. The first subtitle directions he gives you are correct, "somewhere south of Chorrol, but south-west of Fort Carmala." The spoken dialogue for this line replaces south-west with north. Any subsequent time that you ask, both the subtitles and the spoken line will incorrectly say north.

1. After completing Separated at Birth, talk to Guilbert Jemane.
2. Discover Weatherleah and clear it of enemies.
3. Take the brothers to Weatherleah and receive your reward.

**What-If Crucible:**
Guilbert and Reynald Jemane have learned their ancestral home of Weatherleah is infested by ferocious red ogres. (A) Clear the ogres from Weatherleah and escort the Jemane brothers back to their restored family estate: brings closure to the reunited twins. (B) Fortify Weatherleah with wooden palisades: turns the recovered farm into an armed outpost against mountain monsters. (C) Demand half of Weatherleah's land in exchange for reclaiming it: extracts property from the grateful brothers.

(C) Frame the local Leyawiin Khajiit population for the theft: covers for guild infighting while inflaming racial tension along the Southern border.

quests.title: Liberation or Apprehension_
quests.description: Speak to Arch-Mage Traven after completing the quest Necromancer's Moon. He speaks of how you've shown great promise and such, then gets down to the business of your next quest. It seems that in their efforts to gain information about the Necromancers, the Mages Guild has enlisted Mucianus Allias as a spy within the organization. This move has given the guild valuable information, but Traven now feels that the informant is in danger. In particular, Traven is worried that a group of Battlemages sent to find Mucianus by the Council of Mages will mistreat him or even mistake him for one of the necromancers. To prevent this Traven sends you to Nenyond Twyll—Mucianus' last known location—an Ayleid ruin to the south of the Imperial City.

(B) Capture the lead necromancer Mariette Rielle alive for interrogation: extracts vital operational maps of Mannimarco's cell network before executing her. (C) Attempt to reverse Mucianus's zombie curse with experimental restoration: risks severe arcane corruption in a desperate bid to save an imperial patriot.

quests.description: Follow the story of an exiled mage trying to save his friend from himself (non-journal).
quests.notes:
Follow the story of an exiled mage trying to save his friend from himself (non-journal).

**Canonical Outcome:**
You will first find a Weathered Journal outside the front door to the Lost Boy Cavern. This journal was written by a Mage, Vangaril, and describes his realization that his friend Erandur has become a Lich. The Mages Guild refuses to help Vangaril, so he resolves to enter Lost Boy Cavern alone and free Erandur's soul.

1. Note: This quest does not appear in your journal. Also, it is best to only start this quest if you are level 23 or higher; otherwise, you will never be able to complete the quest.
2. Find and read the items that tell the story of Erandur and Vangaril.
3. Combat the lich.

**What-If Crucible:**
The tragic journals of Erandur-Vangaril in Lost Boy Cavern tell of a mage who sacrificed his sanity to bind his lich friend. (A) Slay the tragic lich Erandur-Vangaril, freeing both entwined souls from eternal necrotic torment: cleanses the haunted cavern. (B) Study Erandur's journals on soul-transference: gains deep theoretical insights into necromantic soul binding. (C) Seal the entrance of Lost Boy Cavern with stone wards: leaves the tragic entity undisturbed in eternal subterranean isolation.

quests.description: With the Amulet of Kings reclaimed and Martin Septim under safe watch, all that's left to be done is for Martin to relight the Dragonfires in the Temple of the One, resealing the barrier between Tamriel and Oblivion. However, there is still a matter of regal tradition: Martin wants the Elder Council's blessing to be accepted as Emperor without officially being an heir. For one final task, you must escort him to the Imperial Palace to complete the ceremony and end this ordeal at last. Upon arrival, High Chancellor Ocato greets Martin amiably and is about to officially accept him as Emperor when an exhausted and terrified messenger rushes in reporting Oblivion Gates opening inside the Imperial City's walls!

(C) Urge Martin to search for an alternative ritual: risks the total destruction of Tamriel in a desperate attempt to save Martin's life.

(B) Slay the vampiric Pale Lady in her feeding cell: purges a horrific castle predator while securing the book, but risks raising the castle alarm. (C) Ransom the ancient tome to Count Janus Hassildor: trades the book's historical secrets for aristocratic immunity in Skingrad.

quests.description: Collect alchemy samples to regain your Mages Guild
quests.notes:
Collect alchemy samples to regain your Mages Guild

**Canonical Outcome:**
Upon joining the guild you are presented with a copy of the Mages Guild Charter, which states that any crime committed against a guild member results in suspension. Unlike in the Thieves Guild, however, assault is not counted as a crime and only theft and murder will cause a suspension.

1. After breaking a rule of the Mages Guild, you are told to talk to Raminus Polus.
2. Collect alchemy samples and hand them over to regain your standing.

**What-If Crucible:**
Having broken guild rules or stolen from colleagues, you must collect rare flora to earn reinstatement. (A) Gather 20 Dragon's Tongue and 20 Redwort Flowers through grueling wilderness foraging: demonstrates humble penance and earns clean restoration of guild privileges. (B) Buy the ingredients from underworld smugglers or black-market apothecaries: circumvents manual labor through gold, proving commercial resourcefulness over remorse. (C) Infiltrate the Arch-Mage's herbarium at night to steal the restitution plants: commits further brazen theft under the Council's noses to cheat the suspension penalty.

(B) Force Lord Drad and his wife to work the mines under ogre overseers: delivers ironic, humiliating justice to the abusive slaver aristocracy. (C) Slay both Drad and the ogres: wipes out the entire operation in a storm of steel, pleasing neither faction.

1. After hearing rumors of an Orc claiming to be a knight, speak with the count about her.
2. The Count will demand you to figure out what she wants. Speak to Mazoga; she wants you to find Weebam-Na, a local hunter.
3. Return to the count, and tell him what she said. He tells you about Weebam-Na.

6. After the skirmish, she tells you of her becoming a knight and her experiences. You are free to loot the gang members' corpses.
7. Return to the Count, and he'll give you the opportunity to become a Knight-Errant of the White Stallion.

**What-If Crucible:**
Mazoga, a gruff Orc residing in Castle Leyawiin, claims to be a knight and demands to speak with Count Marius Caro. (A) Help Mazoga track down the bandit Weebam-Na and avenge her fallen friend Ra'vindra: earns Mazoga's fierce, unwavering friendship. (B) Expose Mazoga's criminal past to Count Caro's guards: has the errant Orc arrested, ending her quest for vengeance. (C) Duel Mazoga in the castle courtyard to test her claims of knighthood: earns her respect through honorable martial combat.

(C) Assassinate only the family patriarchs and claim the entire village as your personal fiefdom: exploits the turmoil for political control.

(B) Use Welkynd resonance magic to dismantle the ruin's traps from a distance: clears the ancient capital methodically without awakening dormant undead guardians. (C) Loot the tombs of ancient Ayleid sorcerer-kings alongside the stone: claims First Era magical treasures, provoking the wrath of ancient elven spirits.

quests.name: Necromancer's Moon
quests.title: Necromancer's Moon
quests.description: Find out about Black Soul Gem
quests.notes:
Find out about Black Soul Gem

**Canonical Outcome:**
After completing Vahtacen's Secret, Raminus Polus will tell you that he needs to find information on Black Soul Gems from Tar-Meena. Just head over to the Mystic Archives. When you first talk to Tar-Meena, she'll rage a bit about how she's got too much to do already, but once you mention Black Soul Gems specifically she agrees to help you out. Tar-Meena instructs you to find a book called Necromancer's Moon and mentions that Falcar has borrowed it. The book can be found on a small table in the lower part of the Library. Take it back to Tar-Meena and she'll tell you a little more information on it, as well as on an interesting event called Shade of the Revenant, before sending you back to Raminus.

1. Talk to Raminus Polus. He wants you to speak with Tar-Meena about Black Soul Gems.
2. Speak to Tar-Meena, who can be found at the Mystic Archives. She tells you to find a book called Necromancer's Moon.
3. Find the book in the lower room of the library on a small table. Take it back to Tar-Meena.
4. Bring the book back to Raminus. He'll tell you to talk to Bothiel.
5. Talk to Bothiel. She gives you a hastily scrawled note which you should take back to Raminus.
6. Raminus tells you to go to Dark Fissure Cave at the next Shade of the Revenant to observe the ritual of creating Black Soul Gems.
7. There are three ways to learn about the ritual:
8. * Waiting: Just stay outside the cave until the ritual occurs. It happens one night per week at midnight (a light will shine down on the altar). Just observe.
9. * Fighting: Explore the cave and find a Worm Anchorite. He will be the first person you encounter in the cave and will be immediately visible to you on the left path as soon as you enter the cave. Kill him, then search his body to find a Handwritten Note explaining the ritual (you can also pickpocket the note).
10. * Doing: Cast Soul Trap on the altar yourself when the time is right. This will trigger you "seeing necromancers perform the ritual".
11. Once you've discovered the ritual or retrieved the note, return to Raminus.

**What-If Crucible:**
Traven needs proof of how the Order of the Black Worm creates Black Soul Gems during the Shade of the Revenant. (A) Stake out the altar at Dark Fissure and observe the celestial purple beam corrupting Grand Soul Gems: secures undeniable written evidence for Traven without shedding blood. (B) Ambush the Worm Anchorite during the ritual and seize the newly created Black Soul Gem: claims the dark conduit for yourself, risking retribution from necromancer reinforcements. (C) Perform the dark ritual yourself using the altar: masters the forbidden alchemy of soul-corruption, setting you on the path of necromantic mastery.

quests.title: Next of Kin
quests.description: Next to the Great Oak in Chorrol
quests.notes:
Next to the Great Oak in Chorrol

**Canonical Outcome:**
The entire Draconis Family is your new target. You start this mission only knowing the location of one of the Draconis family members: the mother, Perennia Draconis. She lives all alone on her farm called Applewatch not far west of Bruma. When you arrive at her house, she asks what you are doing there. You can either tell her that you are looking for her children, and she will mistake you for a gift deliveryman, giving you a complete list of her children's whereabouts and 100 gold to buy the gifts, or you can kill her and take the list off her corpse. Be cautious however: years of living alone have left her tougher than she looks and she has a pet dog to defend her, but you shouldn't have too much trouble.

1. Retrieve your next contract from a sack near the roots of the Great Oak tree in Chorrol.
2. Go to Perennia Draconis' home, Applewatch, to kill her and collect a list of her children and their whereabouts. (See the below walkthrough and notes for details on how to kill Perennia and her family without incurring a bounty.)
3. Locate and eliminate the four other family members.
4. Proceed to the Skingrad Castle Courtyard for the next Dead Drop.

**What-If Crucible:**
Perennia Draconis and her four scattered children must all be eradicated. (A) Deceive Perennia into giving you the gift list containing her children's locations before executing her: completes the contract with surgical efficiency across Cyrodiil. (B) Warn one of the children (Caelia in the Leyawiin guard or Matthias in Imperial City): breaks the contract to save an honorable soldier, triggering a Brotherhood executioner on your trail. (C) Frame the Draconis killings as a bandit feud: shields the Brotherhood from provincial scrutiny while terrorizing the local peasantry.

quests.title: Nocturnal
quests.description: Recover the Eye of Nocturnal
quests.notes:
Recover the Eye of Nocturnal

**Canonical Outcome:**
in Tidewater Cave, hidden among the rocks behind an underwater chest]] Nocturnal's Shrine is located off the Yellow Road north of Leyawiin, just past Blankenmarch. On the in game map, it is due west of the words County Leyawiin. Optionally, you can add a map marker to your map by talking to Alves Uvenim in Leyawiin Mages Guild (topic "Daedra shrines"; you must have already read Modern Heretics or have spoken with Ulene Hlervu about "Cheydinhal"). While you need to be at least level 10 to start this quest, an offering is not required. When you approach the shrine, you will be asked to recover the Eye of Nocturnal from a pair of thieves that are hiding out in Leyawiin. :Night among strangers. Secrets in the dark. Nocturnal is here. But my Eye is blind and drowned, stolen from its shrine, and hid in dark waters. To steal from a god is most unwise. In Leyawiin, two Argonians think themselves secret, but the Eye has seen them. Find these thieves in the city that spans the waters. Learn where they hide my Eye. Retrieve the Eye of Nocturnal, mortal, and return it to me, and I shall look favorably upon you.

1. Once you have reached level 10, approach the shrine, and you'll be asked to recover the Eye of Nocturnal from a pair of thieves.
2. Ask around Leyawiin to find out that the thieves are Argonians living in town.
3. Locate the thieves, and speak to them. You will receive a quest message instructing you to eavesdrop on their conversation.
4. Overhear their discussion to learn the Eye is in Tidewater Cave. Recover the artifact, and return it to the shrine.
5. Upon your return, you are rewarded with the Skeleton Key.

**What-If Crucible:**
Nocturnal's Eye was stolen by two Argonian thieves in Leyawiin and hidden in Tidewater Cave. (A) Eavesdrop on Weebam-Na and Bejeen, retrieve the Eye from the flooded troll cave, and return it: earns the Skeleton Key, the unbreakable lockpick. (B) Attempt to harness the mystical divinatory vision of Nocturnal's Eye yourself: gains cosmic sight at the risk of permanent blindness from the Mistress of Shadows. (C) Hand the Argonian thieves over to Count Leyawiin for public trial: enforces mortal law, though Nocturnal mocks your petty legalism.

**Canonical Outcome:**
Once your Fame is 5 or greater, spend some time in the Temple District. A Dunmer woman, Ralsa Norvalo, will approach you to speak about a matter "of the utmost importance to the citizens of the Imperial City". She says her husband Gilen sent her to ask you to meet him at Seridur's house. Follow the quest marker to Seridur's house, located in the Temple District.

1. You are approached by Ralsa Norvalo who asks you to meet her husband at Seridur's house.
2. Meet Seridur, and learn about the Order of the Virtuous Blood.
3. Accept your assignment, and proceed to Roland Jenseric's house.
4. Travel to Roland's cabin and confront him with your intentions. Decide whether you'll kill him now, or listen to his story.
5. If you chose to listen to his story, proceed to Phintias, and interrogate him.
6. Learn of Memorial Cave, and fight your way through to Seridur.
7. Dispatch Seridur, talk to Roland, and return to the Order for your reward.

**What-If Crucible:**
Gwendolyn and Seridur invite you to join the Order of the Virtuous Blood, accusing Roland Jenseric of being a vampire. (A) Investigate Roland's cabin, discover that Seridur is the true vampire, and slay Seridur in Memorial Cave: cleanses the Order and establishes Roland as its true leader. (B) Slay Roland Jenseric on Seridur's word: executes an innocent man, allowing a vampire lord to manipulate Imperial City high society. (C) Blackmail Seridur regarding his vampirism: extorts massive hush money from the undead aristocrat.

**Canonical Outcome:**
Enter Skingrad and you will meet a Wood Elf named Glarthir, who behaves in a disturbed way. He will stop you in the street and ask you to meet him behind the Great Chapel of Julianos, under the Stendarr stain glass window, at midnight. The Great Chapel is contained within the south walls of Skingrad. Once there, he will explain to you that he believes there is a conspiracy against him. If you don't meet with him immediately, he will keep showing up each night around midnight until you talk to him there.

1. Glarthir will approach you on the street and tell you to meet him behind the Great Chapel of Julianos at midnight.
2. Follow through with the meeting and he'll share his thoughts about a conspiracy against him. Glarthir identifies a conspirator and asks you to observe their movements for a day.
3. Optional: Follow the person that Glarthir has identified.
4. Return to Glarthir the next night with your findings. He will give you 150 gold whether you accuse the target or not.
5. Repeat the process for two other potential conspirators. This time, the rewards will be:
6. * If you report that they were not acting suspiciously, he'll give you 150 gold.
7. * If you report that the person was indeed spying on him, and had previously done the same for another target, he'll give you 200 gold.
8. After the third report, if you said that they were all innocent, Glarthir will not believe you. He'll attack you and you must kill him. If you said that at least one was guilty, Glarthir will instruct you to kill the accused. You can:
9. * Kill the intended targets and receive 1000 gold from Glarthir.
10. * Report Glarthir to the authorities and receive 1 Fame.
11. * If you accused Davide Surilie: inform him or his brother that Glarthir wants them dead and they will kill him themselves.

**What-If Crucible:**
Glarthir in Skingrad believes three townspeople are plotting his death and pays you to spy on them. (A) Investigate Bernadette, Toutius, and Davide, proving to Glarthir that they are innocent: triggers his violent madness, forcing you to put him down in self-defense. (B) Confirm Glarthir's paranoid delusions, collecting his gold bounties for each accused: allows an unhinged madman to eliminate peaceful citizens. (C) Report Glarthir's erratic behavior immediately to Captain Dion: puts Glarthir in the guard's protective custody, preventing bloodshed.

quests.name: Permanent Retirement
quests.title: Permanent Retirement
quests.description: The mini-quest to get your next contract from Ocheeva is named "The Assassin's Gambit". She tells you that you must kill Adamus Phillida, a recently retired Imperial Legion officer, who has taken up residence in the City Watch barracks in Leyawiin. For this task, you have been given an enchanted arrow called the Rose of Sithis. The Rose of Sithis is specially commissioned and crafted to kill one person--in this case, Adamus Phillida. When fired on anyone else, it only wounds them. If you can hit Phillida with the arrow when he is not wearing his armor, the strike will be fatal. Head to Leyawiin, stalk Adamus Phillida, and attack when the moment is right. The contract will be complete when Phillida is dead, whether you use the Rose of Sithis or not. When Adamus Phillida is dead, you can return to the Sanctuary for your reward. If you want to receive your bonus, however, there is one more task you must complete. Phillida wears an Imperial Legion ring. Take his finger, with the ring still attached, and put it in the desk of Phillida's Imperial Legion successor, in his office in the Imperial City.

(B) Absorb the lingering soul energies of the frozen followers: claims forbidden Daedric endurance while leaving the cultists trapped forever. (C) Awaken the cultists and dismantle their summoning shrine: prevents future foolish summoning accidents in Cyrodiil's wilderness.

quests.description: Just outside of the Leyawiin west gate you should meet a legion guard called Lerexus Callidus. Apparently, there is a drug trafficking problem, and he will ask you to help him put a stop to it. He tells you about Kylius Lonavo, a ringleader of Skooma dealers in the Greyland settlement. Lerexus firmly believes the only way to end the trafficking problem is to kill Kylius. You are asked to travel to Greyland, kill Kylius and any of his accomplices, and bring back Kylius' ring as proof of his death.

The last known location of the bandits is Camp Ales, to the far west of Cyrodiil. If you start a new game with this download loaded, the note and quest will be given to you when you emerge from the sewers into the daylight at the end of the tutorial level.

(B) Reverse-engineer the dwarven gears: adapts ancient automaton engineering for custom gear and traps. (C) Sell the dwarven mechanisms to an independent collector in Morrowind: profits off rare First Era brass artifacts.

quests.name: Sanguine
quests.title: Sanguine
quests.description: Crash a dinner party at Castle Leyawiin
quests.notes:
Crash a dinner party at Castle Leyawiin

**Canonical Outcome:**
The Shrine of Sanguine is roughly northwest of Skingrad and southeast of Fort Dirich at the edge of the treeline. Speaking to Fadus Calidius in Skingrad Fighters Guild or Falanu Hlaalu at All Things Alchemical will reveal the location of the shrine on your map (you must have already read Modern Heretics or have spoken with Ulene Hlervu about "Cheydinhal" for the topic to appear). You must be at least level 8 to start this quest. At the shrine, Engorm will tell you that you need to give Sanguine some Cyrodilic Brandy for him to grant an audience with you. Cyrodilic Brandy can be stolen from many nobles' houses; it can also be bought at the Main Ingredient or the Gilded Carafe in the Imperial City. Also, Bogrum Gro-Galash in the Lonely Suitor Lodge in Bravil has a chance of having it in stock. Three samples can be found inside the Odiil Farm just outside of Chorrol, one sample is found at Cloud Ruler Temple in Jauffre's room, and one can be found in Baenlin's House. With the preliminaries taken care of, approach Sanguine and offer the brandy. He will say: :Ah... another mortal come to beg Sanguine to add a bit of spice to an otherwise drab existence. I would have you perform a service for me. The Castle Leyawiin is a dull, dreary place. The mistress is an especially somber soul, and tomorrow she will hold another excruciating dinner party. I want you to liven it up. Use this spell on the Countess and her guests. I think it will make the party much more interesting. You should probably try to be inconspicuous. Or they might kill you. Oh, and the party is by invitation only. You'll have to find a way in. Have fun!

1. Once you have reached level 8, give Sanguine an offering of Cyrodilic Brandy to start the quest.
2. Go to Leyawiin and play a prank at the countess' dinner party using Sanguine's spell.
3. Flee from the guards in Leyawiin (while stark naked).
4. Return to Sanguine to recover your gear and receive your reward: the Sanguine Rose, a staff that summons random Daedra.

**What-If Crucible:**
Sanguine commands you to cast the 'Stark Reality' spell on Countess Alessia Caro's haughty dinner party in Castle Leyawiin. (A) Infiltrate the banquet, cast the spell to strip every noble completely naked, and flee the guards: earns the staff of the Sanguine Rose from the Prince of Hedonism. (B) Cast the spell on the city guards outside instead: turns the city watch into an embarrassing spectacle while sparing the diplomatic banquet. (C) Spike the banquet punch bowl with enchanted vintage wine: creates a roaring tavern-style revelry without stripping the nobility, finding a middle ground.

**Canonical Outcome:**
This quest picks up immediately from the previous quest, A Wound In Time. Upon informing Ilav about the magical barrier within Beldaburo, he will cast a blessing on you to allow you to pass through the barrier. He will task you with recovering the Order of the Hour's Elder Scroll before it can be used to open a Time Wound.

1. Receive the Order's blessing from Ilav Dralgoner.
2. Return to Beldaburo and enter the second zone, Beldaburo Anga.
3. Defeat Corelian and take the Elder Scroll from their corpse.
4. Speak with Ilav for your reward.

**What-If Crucible:**
A metaphysical chronomantic disruption threatens the integrity of Cyrodiil's historical narrative. (A) Recalibrate the Elder Scroll temporal anchor: seals the disruption and preserves the linear history of the Septim dynasty. (B) Glimpse alternative timelines where Kvatch never fell: extracts parallel tactical strategies from divergent realities. (C) Allow minor temporal echoes to bleed into Cyrodiil: creates strange historical phenomena for arcane study.

The collector, Herminia Cinna, refuses to sell it to Umbacano, and he is hoping you can convince her to sell it to you. He gives you 1000 septims to purchase the crown, and tells you that you can keep whatever you do not spend; possibly encouraging you to steal it.

1. WARNING: It is recommended that you find and sell all ten Ayleid statues to Umbacano before Stage 60 of this quest. After this point, The Collector cannot be completed successfully.
2. After you return with the carving from the High Fane, Umbacano will give you the next assignment.
3. Receive 1000 gold towards "persuading" a rival collector to hand over the crown of the last king of the Ayleids.
4. Proceed to Herminia Cinna's home, and choose whether to steal her crown or retrieve another one.
5. Either way, return to Umbacano with your findings, and he will instruct you to act as his bodyguard at Nenalata.
6. Depending on your actions, you will kill Umbacano and his summoned creatures. After the brawl (or fleeing), make your way out of Nenalata.

**What-If Crucible:**
Umbacano wants you to find the ancient Crown of Nenalata or the Crown of Lindai to claim the Ayleid throne. (A) Give Umbacano the cursed Crown of Lindai, causing the ancient throne at Nenalata to incinerate him: frees Cyrodiil from a reincarnated Ayleid tyrant. (B) Give Umbacano the authentic Crown of Nenalata: watches him transform into an ancient Ayleid sorcerer-king, forcing an epic boss duel. (C) Keep both Ayleid crowns for yourself: crowns yourself heir to the ancient Wild Elves, donning master-tier elven regalia.

quests.name: Seeking Your Roots
quests.title: Seeking Your Roots
quests.description: After discovering a peculiar plant called Nirnroot
quests.notes:
After discovering a peculiar plant called Nirnroot

**Canonical Outcome:**
Nirnroot is a very noticeable, vibrant, greenish-blue plant with four large leaves, usually located close to water and emitting a quiet ringing noise. There are hundreds of locations where the plant can be found, but unlike every other plant in the game it does not regrow; each plant can only be harvested once. As a result, it is considered to be a rare plant. Details on where the plant can be found are provided on the Nirnroot page.

1. Harvest Nirnroot for the first time to be given a new quest. You should ask an alchemist about it.
2. Question alchemists to get no useful information other than to see Sinderion in Skingrad.
3. Find Sinderion in his cellar at the West Weald Inn in Skingrad. Ask him about Nirnroot, and he'll tell you a story.
4. He tells you to collect a certain number of Nirnroot which you should return to him. He'll tell you to wait 24 hours that so he may finish his research. When he's done, he rewards you with a potion, and you should repeat the process three more times.
5. When you've gone through this a total of four times, he'll have exhausted his research, and from now on he'll just pay in gold for any Nirnroot that you should return to him.

**What-If Crucible:**
Sinderion in Skingrad needs batches of rare, glowing Nirnroot plants to brew the Elixir of Exploration. (A) Forage 100 Nirnroots along the rivers, lakes, and coasts of Cyrodiil: earns all four tiers of the Elixir of Exploration, granting permanent stat buffs. (B) Cultivate Nirnroot domestic seedlings in your private manor gardens: attempts the first successful artificial cultivation of the elusive plant. (C) Sell the Nirnroot samples to underground poisoners: brews lethal silent toxins from the plant's vibrational sap.

quests.description: Fulfill an apocalyptic prophecy to satisfy Shivering:Sheogorath
quests.notes:
Fulfill an apocalyptic prophecy to satisfy Shivering:Sheogorath

**Canonical Outcome:**
Sheogorath's Shrine is located on the border to Elsweyr, halfway between Bravil and Leyawiin. You must find the shrine on your own; no one will tell you where it is. You must be at least level 2 to start this quest. Once you reach his shrine, talk to Ferul Ravel. You will be told to supply a head of lettuce, a Lesser Soul Gem, and yarn. All are quite common; lettuce and yarn are commonly found in random house clutter, and both are guaranteed to be in a number of homes in Border Watch. The Lesser Soul Gem might be slightly more tricky to find; several locations in Bravil, such as the local Mages Guild and the nearby magic shop A Warlock's Luck may have them. If the Shivering Isles expansion is installed, many shrines to Sheogorath in the city of New Sheoth will have these offerings.

1. Once you have reached level 2, travel to the Shrine of Sheogorath and speak with Ferul Ravel.
2. Acquire one sample of Lettuce, a Lesser Soul Gem, and a spool of Yarn and offer them to the shrine.
3. Travel to Border Watch and set up the plague of Disease and the plague of Famine.
4. Return to Sheogorath after he completes this "apocalypse", and receive Wabbajack as your reward.

**What-If Crucible:**
Sheogorath wants you to terrorize the superstitious Khajiit village of Border Watch by fulfilling three apocalyptic omens. (A) Steal the Olroy cheese, summon the vermin, kill the livestock, and trigger the rain of burning dogs: delights the Madgod and earns the chaotic Wabbajack. (B) Warn Ri'Bassa that Sheogorath's omens are being artificially orchestrated: spares the village mental terror, though Sheogorath mocks your lack of imagination. (C) Exploit the mass hysteria to convince the Khajiit to relocate closer to Leyawiin: turns the supernatural prank into an economic migration.

quests.title: The Assassinated Man
quests.description: Speak with Vicente Valtieri in the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary to complete the "To Serve Sithis" mini-quest and receive Vicente's final contract. It seems Francois Motierre in Chorrol borrowed a lot of money from underworld types and has missed a payment. The lenders don't even want the money. They feel insulted and want him dead, sending an enforcer to kill him. Francois has hired The Dark Brotherhood to fake his death and take the life of his mother instead, a detail Vicente tells you has already been handled by Lucien Lachance. Vicente gives you the tools you'll need to fake Motierre's death: a single-use dagger coated with a special poison called Languorwine that can make it appear that a person has died, and an antidote to revive him later.

quests.name: The Battle for Castle Kvatch
quests.title: The Battle for Castle Kvatch
quests.description: Try to save the Count of Kvatch
quests.notes:
Try to save the Count of Kvatch

**Canonical Outcome:**
Whenever you're ready, speak to Savlian Matius to begin the battle to free Kvatch Castle. Follow him and any of the survivors from your efforts to the break the city's siege out of the chapel. Savlian is marked as essential, so he cannot be killed, but the rest of your allies are mortal and unleveled. Keeping them alive—although optional—is a challenge at high levels (see the Notes section for tips).

1. Help Savlian Matius fight through the Daedra to reach the castle gates.
2. You are sent to Berich Inian in the Chapel of Akatosh to collect the key to the guard house.
3. Acquire the key, rally your new reinforcements, and make your way through the tunnels to get to the gatehouse and open the gates.
4. Reach and storm the castle, clearing out the Daedra infestation.
5. Find the count's corpse, and recover his signet ring.
6. Return to Savlian Matius with news of the count's death and his ring to finish the quest, and receive your reward.

**What-If Crucible:**
Savlian Matius launches a counterattack to reclaim Castle Kvatch and find Count Ormellius Goldwine. (A) Breach Castle Kvatch with Matius, fight through the blazing courtyard, and discover the fallen Count: secures the Count's signet ring and drives the Daedra from Kvatch. (B) Search the royal vaults while Savlian fights the Dremora in the throne room: retrieves ancient Colovian treasures before reporting the Count's tragic demise. (C) Offer Savlian Matius emotional counsel as he mourns his fallen comrades: helps the surviving captain shoulder the burden of ruling a ruined city.

**Canonical Outcome:**
Your next dead drop location is a hollowed-out tree stump in the Market District of the Imperial City, behind Stonewall Shields. Your orders instruct you to travel to Gnoll Mountain to kill Havilstein Hoar-Blood. According to the dead drop orders, he murdered a mead hall chieftain back on Solstheim and the victim's sister wants bloody revenge. This is out of the ordinary, as Nord tradition dictates some form of material compensation.

1. Receive the next contract from the hollowed-out tree stump behind Stonewall Shields.
2. Make your way up the mountain to Hoar-Blood.
3. Decide how you will kill him and his wolf companion.
4. Make your way to the next dead drop.

**What-If Crucible:**
Havilstein Hoar-Blood, a Nord barbarian encampment leader, lives atop the snowy Gnoll Mountain. (A) Ambush Havilstein while he sleeps beside his wolf companion: avoids a brutal melee battle against his enchanted frost battleaxe. (B) Challenge Havilstein to an honorable duel of warriors: tests your martial prowess against a mountain warlord, but risks alerting nearby mountain bandits. (C) Subdue his loyal wolf Red and turn it against him: exploits his sentimental weakness at the cost of emotional brutality.

Selling this statue to a merchant will net you a maximum of 250 septims. The statue disappears from the merchant's inventory as soon as you exit the barter screen. After selling the statue, expect to be approached by a messenger after a short period of time. The messenger will take you to Umbacano's Manor in the Talos Plaza District, where you find out that he has purchased the statue from the merchant. Alternatively, take the first statue directly to Umbacano. Enter his manor and show the statue to his butler, Jollring, who will then introduce you to Umbacano. Umbacano will then buy the statue for 500 gold, which is double its base value.

quests.title: The Crimson Cave
quests.description: Attend a secret meeting of the Mythic Dawn
quests.notes:
Attend a secret meeting of the Mythic Dawn

**Canonical Outcome:**
After completing the Burning Trail, Ranaline will tell you to go to Mingo Cave while dressed as a member of the Mythic Dawn. She will mark the cave on your map; it is located south of Hircine's Shrine. If you wish to infiltrate the meeting, be sure to put on the Mythic Dawn Hood and Robe given to you by Ranaline before entering the cave. If you unequip either of them while inside, the cultists will turn hostile. Of course, there is nothing preventing you from immediately going on the offensive if you prefer to attack the cultists immediately.

1. Go to Mingo Cave south of Hircine's Shrine.
2. (Optional) Equip a set of Mythic Dawn robes and hood before entering the cave to infiltrate the cult.
3. Head directly north through the cave until you enter the room with three cages.
4. Talk with Mehrunes' Harbinger.
5. Activate the Pyre Wood to burn the caged prisoner or kill all the cultists.
6. Speak with Mehrunes' Harbinger and learn the Summon Mehrunes' Harbinger spell. Use the spell and speak with the Harbinger again to finish the quest.

**What-If Crucible:**
Bandits have converted an ancient red-veined cavern into a heavily fortified smuggling redoubt. (A) Infiltrate Crimson Cave, eliminate the outlaw garrison, and recover stolen trade goods: clears a major chokepoint along the trade route. (B) Negotiate a toll-sharing treaty with the bandit captain: collects passive highway revenue at the cost of merchant grumbling. (C) Flood the cavern using nearby river sluices: washes the bandits away without entering combat.

quests.description: Deliver a weapons shipment to the Desolate Mine
quests.notes:

**Canonical Outcome:**
This first Cheydinhal Fighters Guild quest - together with the first Anvil Fighters Guild quests, A Rat Problem and The Unfortunate Shopkeeper - is required for advancement in the guild and proceeding to Unfinished Business, but it is completely independent of the other two in terms of order of completion. You can receive this quest before, during, or after any of the Anvil quests.

1. Speak with Burz gro-Khash. He needs you to bring a weapon cache to some guild members at the Desolate Mine.
2. Make your way to the mine and take care of any enemies guarding the entrance.
3. Once inside, speak with Rienna.
4. After discovering how each member prefers to kill goblins, distribute the weapons appropriately.
5. Head into the bowels of the mine with the other three guild members and eliminate all standing resistance.
6. Once the mine is clear, return to Burz gro-Khash for your reward.

**What-If Crucible:**
Goblins have infested Desolate Mine near Cheydinhal, threatening local miners and supply routes. (A) Equip the greenhorn guild recruits with specialized weapons and lead an organized assault: clears the mine with zero guild casualties and earns Burz gro-Khash's praise. (B) Charge the goblin chieftains alone, leaving the recruits in reserve: claims the glory and combat experience single-handedly, but damages team morale. (C) Collapse the mine entrance with explosive spells: seals the goblins inside forever, but ruins the iron mine's economic viability for Cheydinhal.

quests.title: The Fugitives
quests.description: Find and kill some fugitives that have been causing trouble near Bravil
quests.notes:
Find and kill some fugitives that have been causing trouble near Bravil

**Canonical Outcome:**
Speak with Burz gro-Khash in Cheydinhal to learn about a prison escape in Bravil where four fugitives are terrorizing the locals. You are sent to Bravil to round up the fugitives and show them the error of their ways. Travel to Bravil and speak to the locals about the fugitives. You will probably find that most of them are reluctant to speak to you due to their instilled fear. Most likely, you will have to be a bit persuasive. After persuading the locals to loosen their tongues, you will learn that the four fugitives are hiding out in Bloodmayne Cave, located northwest of Bravil near the Larsius River. The location of the fugitives' hideout will be conveniently marked on your map.

1. Speak with Burz gro-Khash to receive this contract.

quests.description: On the west side of Anvil Docks, there's a ship called The Serpent's Wake. Speak with Varulae, who is standing on the main deck. Inside the first door is a ghost that will sometimes stay in the room, so you can use a ranged spell to kill it easily, even at a low level. Once a ghost dies it leaves a sharpened cutlass, which can be used to fight other ghosts.

quests.description: Return to Blackwood Company
quests.notes:
Return to Blackwood Company

**Canonical Outcome:**
Once again, speak with Modryn Oreyn at his house in Chorrol. The Blackwood Company must be eradicated and Modryn tasks you with heading back to the Blackwood Company Hall in Leyawiin, finding Ri'Zakar and destroying the source of the Company's strength. You must be careful, however, as the Company now know your position and are unlikely to provide with a friendly greeting.

1. Speak with Modryn Oreyn at his home in Chorrol once again.
2. Travel to the Blackwood Company Hall in Leyawiin, kill Ja'Fazir and loot the key to Jeetum-Ze's room from his body.
3. Enter Jeetum-Ze's room and kill him. Loot the key to Ri'Zakar's room from his body.
4. Enter Ri'Zakar's room and kill him. Loot the key to the Blackwood Company Basement from his body.
5. Enter the basement, kill two more Blackwood members and destroy the Hist tree.
6. After having slain an enraged Maglir, return to Modryn Oreyn's house in Chorrol for your reward.
7. Speak to Vilena Donton to be named Master of the Fighters Guild.
8. Return to Modryn Oreyn's house and speak with him to complete the Fighters Guild questline.

**What-If Crucible:**
Having uncovered the Blackwood Company's secret, you must destroy the corrupted Hist tree in their Leyawiin basement. (A) Sabotage the Hist tree's pumping machinery and slay Ri'Zakar: destroys the corrupted tree, dissolves the Blackwood Company, and avenges Water's Edge. (B) Preserve a clipping of the corrupted Hist root for alchemical study: risks spreading the unnatural sap in exchange for unparalleled biological enhancement. (C) Challenge Ri'Zakar to an honorable warrior duel in his office: settles the guild war with martial dignity before torching the laboratory.

quests.title: The Horror of Dive Rock
quests.description: Slay the Horror of Dive Rock
quests.notes:
Slay the Horror of Dive Rock

**Canonical Outcome:**
At Dive Rock, near the campfire, you can find Agnar's Journal. This diary tells how Agnar the Unwavering became the chieftain of Thirsk Mead Hall on Solstheim and married Svenja Snow-Song, at some point after an earlier chieftain had rid Thirsk of the fearsome Udyrfrykte. (The earlier chieftain is actually the player of Morrowind, having done The Mead Hall Massacre quest in Bloodmoon.) However, Svenja was still haunted by the memory of the Uderfrykte and the possibility of future attacks, so to rid herself of her nightmares and fears, Svenja felt driven to slay the mother of all the Uderfryktes, the Uderfrykte Matron. Hearing of a horrible creature near Dive Rock, Agnar and Svenja traveled there. In the final diary entry, Agnar the Unwavering had just wavered and fled after his and Svenja's attack on the Uderfrykte Matron had failed miserably. Agnar was about to head back and avenge his wife's death.

1. Note: This quest does not appear in your journal
2. Find and read Agnar's Journal.
3. Locate and destroy the Uderfrykte Matron, loot the corpse to find Frostwyrm Bow, and learn of Agnar's fate.

**What-If Crucible:**
The journals of Agnar and Svenja atop Dive Rock tell of the legendary monstrous Uderfrykte Matron. (A) Track down the Uderfrykte Matron in the freezing blizzard, avenge the fallen lovers, and slay the beast: earns the Frostwyrm Bow. (B) Tame the mountain predator using beast mastery: turns Cyrodiil's most terrifying myth into a mountain guardian. (C) Recover Agnar's journal and return it to his kin in Skyrim: brings honorable Nord closure to a tragic saga.

**Canonical Outcome:**
Once you have been promoted to the rank of Wizard after completing A Plot Revealed, the Arch-Mage will inform you that the Council is in ruins after the events of the previous quest (after having just fallen into disarray upon being informed of the return of Mannimarco). As a part of this more recent upheaval, two artifacts, the Necromancer's Amulet and the Bloodworm Helm, were removed from the University by Caranya and Irlav Jarol, respectively. Having continued misgivings for the safety of the items and their current caretakers, the Arch-Mage wants you to retrieve the items back to the University for safekeeping.

1. Speak to Hannibal Traven a few days after completing A Plot Revealed. He wants you to retrieve the Necromancer's Amulet from Fort Ontus.

**What-If Crucible:**
Caranya has taken the Necromancer's Amulet to Fort Ontus, plotting to defect to Mannimarco. (A) Confront and execute Caranya when she reveals her treason, returning the amulet to the University: eliminates a high-ranking traitor and seals Traven's defense perimeter. (B) Agree to hear Caranya's argument regarding Traven's dogmatic suppression of magical evolution: gains deeper philosophical understanding of the schism before making your choice. (C) Keep the Necromancer's Amulet equipped during battle: leverages its massive willpower and intelligence buffs to obliterate the fort's cultists.

quests.description: Things at the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary
quests.notes:
Things at the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary

**Canonical Outcome:**
The "Of Secret And Shadow" mini-quest directs you to talk to Ocheeva. She tells you that you have received a letter from Lucien. Apparently the Black Hand itself has a task for you. For more details, you need to travel to Lucien's current residence in Fort Farragut, just northeast of Cheydinhal. The letter also warns you that you must not speak to anyone in the Sanctuary about the letter and you should be careful about the residents of the fort.

1. Read Lucien's letter to you.
2. Meet him in Fort Farragut.
3. Eliminate everyone in the Sanctuary.
4. Return to Lucien for your reward and your new way to receive contracts.

**What-If Crucible:**
Lucien Lachance commands you to purge the entire Cheydinhal Sanctuary to cleanse a traitor. (A) Systematically slaughter Ocheeva, Vicente, Antoinetta, Gogron, and Teinaava: fulfills the dark command unquestioningly, earning Shadowmere and the rank of Silencer. (B) Poison the Sanctuary's shared food stores with poisoned apples: eliminates your family painlessly in their sleep, minimizing combat trauma. (C) Attempt to warn Ocheeva or Vicente of Lucien's order: discovers that Sanctuary wards prevent escape, forcing a tragic fratricide under Sithis's watchful gaze.

quests.title: The Renegade Shadowscale
quests.description: Eradicate a fugitive Shadowscale named Scar-Tail
quests.notes:
Eradicate a fugitive Shadowscale named Scar-Tail

**Canonical Outcome:**
Any time after you have finished Scheduled for Execution, talking to Teinaava reveals that he has a personal matter that he would like to discuss. Teinaava will only offer to discuss the topic if his disposition towards you is greater than 70. If you say that you are interested, he will reveal that his fellow Shadowscale, Scar-Tail, fled the Black Marsh, violating code, and refuses to return. Because Shadowscale cannot kill their own kin, as in the Dark Brotherhood, he has contacted you to do the dirty work. You are to bring back the Argonian's heart as proof.

1. Speak to Teinaava about Scar-Tail.
2. Head to Bogwater camp, and meet Scar-Tail.
3. Decide what you will do with him.
4. Bring Teinaava the heart of an Argonian to collect your reward.

**What-If Crucible:**
Teinaava secretly asks you to hunt down his rogue Shadowscale brother Scar-Tail in Bogwater. (A) Hunt Scar-Tail down and carve out his heart for Teinaava: upholds the ancient Argonian Shadowscale tradition and claims Teinaava's reward. (B) Accept Scar-Tail's offer to take a dead Argonian agent's heart instead: spares the fugitive to live in peace, deceiving Teinaava with forged biological proof. (C) Slay both Scar-Tail and his pursuer to keep Scar-Tail's buried hoard: maximizes personal wealth while extinguishing the last remnants of the Bogwater clan.

**Canonical Outcome:**
Speak to Azzan in Anvil. He will tell you that Modryn Oreyn has been kicked out of the Guild as a result of Viranus Donton's death at Forsaken Mine. If you have not yet completed Burz's last two quests, Azzan will also inform you that you have been demoted to Defender for your part in the affair. 1. Speak with Azzan in Anvil to receive this contract.
2. Travel to the Chapel of Talos in Bruma and speak with Cirroc about the theft of the Stone of St. Alessia by bandits.
3. Follow the bandits out of town - heading east - and you will encounter K'Sharr, one of their members.
4. K'Sharr will tell you that ogres stole the Stone from the bandits. The ogres are holed up in Sedor - an Ayleid ruin (quite a ways) to the east.
5. Proceed to Sedor and retrieve the Stone, evading or eliminating any ogres you encounter.
6. Return the Stone to Cirroc and he will reward you with three Strong Potions of Healing.
7. Report back to Azzan for payment and he will inform you that he has no more contracts for you.

**What-If Crucible:**
Ogres have raided the Chapel of Talos in Bruma and stolen the sacred Stone of St. Alessia. (A) Track the ogre raiders to Sedor, recover the holy stone, and return it to Cirroc: restores holy blessings to Bruma and bolsters Imperial faith. (B) Channel the stone's sacred Alessian divine energy to permanently bless your party: claims ancient saintly resilience at the cost of sacrilegious chapel theft. (C) Ransom the relic back to the Elder Council: forces imperial bureaucrats to pay exorbitant sums for their own historical heritage.

quests.name: The Ultimate Heist
quests.title: The Ultimate Heist
quests.description: Once more, Amusei summons you to see the Gray Fox. This time Amusei will send you to Othrelos' house in the Imperial City. The last three quests were a preparation for the ultimate job: retrieve an Elder Scroll from the Imperial Palace. He makes no secret that this will be a most dangerous and daring task and warns you to be prepared. He gives a detailed plan for the heist, involving going through the sewers into the Old Way (an old escape route) to reach the Elder Library, impersonating Celia Camoran to intercept the scroll, and making the getaway. He gives you an Imperial Sewer Key for access to the Palace Sewers, the restored Arrow of Extrication, and the Boots of Springheel Jak. He also tells you that there will be no blood price during this quest.

1. After fencing at least 1000 gold in stolen items, the Gray Fox will contact you for a mission.
2. Sneak into the Imperial Palace Basement and activate the Glass of Time to enter the Imperial City's sewers.
3. Make your way through The Old Way and The Lost Catacombs to the Hall of Epochs.
4. Sneak through the Imperial Palace to the Elder Library.
5. After receiving the Elder Scroll, escape from the Imperial Battlemage's Room and return to the Gray Fox.

7. After some secrets are revealed, accept the Gray Cowl of Nocturnal to become the new Thieves Guild Guildmaster and Gray Fox.

**What-If Crucible:**
The Gray Fox leads the heist of the era: infiltrate the Imperial Palace via the Old Way and steal an Elder Scroll. (A) Navigate the glass sewers, fire the Arrow of Extrication, slip past the Blind Moth Priests, and escape with the Elder Scroll: breaks Corvus Umbranox's curse and crowns you the new Gray Fox. (B) Slay the Blind Moth Priests to seize their ancient divine texts: accelerates the escape at the cost of massacring holy blind monks. (C) Read the Elder Scroll during your escape: glimpses cosmic truth about the Aurbis at the cost of permanent ocular strain and mental vertigo.

Look outside on the eastern side of Fort Coldcorn, on the big wall around the back of the fort. The fort's walls can be easily climbed onto from the northwest of the fort. East of there you will find a chest containing random loot (including 10% chance of enchanted jewelry and 5% chance of an enchanted weapon), a Key of Hidden Wealth, and a strange note. Next to the chest is a fine steel longsword. The note reads: :The sword leads the way. :Half a mile. :It's just past the big rock on the right.

1. Note: This quest does not appear in your journal
2. Find and read the strange note on the eastern side of Fort Coldcorn outside the fort.
3. Find the hidden treasure by following the clue you have been given.

Explore uncharted paths and ancient wilderness ruins winding through the Colovian Highlands. (A) Map the ancient trails, clear wild monster nests, and establish marked waypoints: makes the Colovian frontier safe for pilgrims. (B) Ambush merchant caravans along the secluded trails: exploits the lack of guard patrols for highway plunder. (C) Establish a hidden hunter's redoubt in the highlands: creates an off-grid mountain refuge.

quests.name: Tutorial
quests.title: Tutorial
quests.description: You must follow the Imperial Prison Sewer (Tutorial)
quests.notes:
You must follow the Imperial Prison Sewer (Tutorial)

**Canonical Outcome:**
The game begins in a bare prison cell with little more to your name than your clothing: a sack cloth shirt, pants, and sandals along with wrist irons. As you explore the cell and become accustomed to your surroundings, a prisoner in the cell opposite yours threatens and berates you. When he's finished, the Emperor of Tamriel, Uriel Septim VII, and three of his bodyguards arrive at your cell and are surprised to find you in it. One guard orders you to stand aside and then the Emperor steps in. As he enters, the Emperor recognizes you from a prophetic dream, and explains that his bodyguards, the Blades, are leading him through a secret escape route. The reason for the guards' surprise becomes clear: the cell you occupy was supposed to be left empty because the route happens to start in your cell. The Emperor pardons you of any crimes you may have committed, and allows you to follow him for a time.

1. Walk up to the cell door and speak with Valen Dreth, a fellow prisoner.
2. Follow the secret escape route through the sewers.
3. Meet back with the Emperor and continue to follow him.
4. Take the Amulet of Kings and exit the sewers.

**What-If Crucible:**
Escape the Imperial Prison dungeons with Emperor Uriel Septim VII and the Blades through secret subterranean escape routes. (A) Guard Emperor Uriel Septim to his final breath, receiving the Amulet of Kings and his dying charge: sets your hero's destiny into motion with sacred duty. (B) Pick the locks and explore every forgotten cell and goblin cavern along the sewer route: gathers critical starting lockpicks, spells, and gear before reaching the surface. (C) Question the Emperor regarding his prophetic dreams of your face: delves into the mysteries of predestination and mortal will before the assassin strikes.

quests.name: Ulterior Motives
quests.title: Ulterior Motives
quests.description: Retrieve a book from the Janus Hassildor
quests.notes:
Retrieve a book from the Janus Hassildor

**Canonical Outcome:**
After completing A Mage's Staff, speak to Raminus Polus to receive your next task, which is related to the Necromancers you found at Wellspring Cave. All he wants is for you to retrieve a book from Janus Hassildor, Count of Skingrad. He warns you that Skingrad can be an "unusual place".

1. Speak with Raminus Polus. He tells you to travel to Skingrad and retrieve a book from the Count.
2. When you arrive at Castle Skingrad, you will be directed to Mercator Hosidus who tells you the Count will not see you, but suggests you return tomorrow.
3. The next day, Mercator will tell you the Count has agreed to meet you away from prying eyes at 2am, north of Cursed Mine.
4. Go to the meeting point, which is actually southeast of the mine, where you are ambushed by Mercator and his fellow Necromancers. The Count of Skingrad will also arrive during the fight.
5. Afterwards, the Count speaks to you about the delicate relationship between himself and the guild, a pretense you can see in his eyes.
6. When all is understood, return to Raminus for a promotion and the Spelldrinker Amulet.

**What-If Crucible:**
Traven sends you to retrieve a book from Count Janus Hassildor in Skingrad, unaware of the Count's secret motives. (A) Deliver Traven's request and uncover that the Council is using you as an unwitting spy against the Count: navigates courtly intrigue without provoking Hassildor's anger. (B) Slay the ambushers sent by the Necromancer cult outside Skingrad: proves your worth as the Council's elite enforcer and earns Hassildor's respect. (C) Agree to act as a double-agent between Hassildor and Traven: balances imperial guild interests against the independent autonomy of County Skingrad.

quests.title: Unearthing Mehrunes Razor
quests.description: Conquer one of the deepest and most challenging Sundercliff Watch
quests.notes:
Conquer one of the deepest and most challenging Sundercliff Watch

**Canonical Outcome:**
The lost Ayleid City Varsa Baalim has been unearthed by a rogue Telvanni arch-mage in pursuit of a fearsome Daedric Artifact, Mehrunes Razor, which he believes will give him the power he needs to topple the Imperial reign—but what horrors lie in wait beneath the Valus mountains, and can you overcome them to claim Mehrunes Razor as your own?

1. Make your way into Sundercliff Watch and Sundercliff Village.
2. Find Frathen Drothan's cabin and read his journal.
3. Find the Drothmeri Commander and the Forgemaster to retrieve an Enchanted Bezoar from each.
4. Place the bezoars in the Enchanted Pedestals to open the entrance to Varsa Baalim.
5. Explore Varsa Baalim to find the entrance to the Nefarivigum.
6. Kill Frathen Drothan and retrieve Mehrunes Razor.

**What-If Crucible:**
Frathen Drothan has unearthed the ancient Ayleid ruin of Varsa Baalim to reclaim the dreaded Mehrunes' Razor. (A) Infiltrate Varsa Baalim, defeat Drothan's mercenaries and vampire minions, and claim Mehrunes' Razor: secures the legendary Daedric dagger of instant death. (B) Destroy the ancient Nefarivigum altar: seals the dark relic away forever to prevent future tyrants from wielding it. (C) Harness Drothan's research to enhance the Razor's soul-banishing enchantments: creates an even deadlier variant.

**Canonical Outcome:**
At the Imperial City Market District speak to some of the merchants. Upon speaking to the merchants (either Tertullian Verus, Claudette Perrick or Ogier Georick) you will learn of a new merchant in town, Thoronir, whom the other merchants don't trust. 2. Speak with Thoronir and learn about his inventory. When he leaves, follow him.
3. Eavesdrop on the conversation then follow Agarmir to his house.
4. Find the Macabre Manifest in the basement and confront Thoronir with it.

Thoronir is underselling other Imperial City merchants; Jensine suspects he is obtaining goods through foul means. (A) Trail Thoronir, discover his grave-robbing supplier Agarmir, and slay Agarmir in the crypt: reforms Thoronir and restores honest commerce to the Market District. (B) Blackmail Thoronir into giving you wholesale discounts on grave-robbed goods: profits from desecration while keeping the supply open. (C) Turn both Thoronir and Agarmir over to the Imperial Watch: shuts down the store, eliminating an affordable vendor.

quests.title: Vahtacen's Secret
quests.description: Find out how the Mages Guild's excavation of Vahtacen
quests.notes:
Find out how the Mages Guild's excavation of Vahtacen

**Canonical Outcome:**
After being promoted to Evoker (i.e. after completing Ulterior Motives), speak to Raminus Polus for your next task. Raminus tells you to speak with Irlav Jarol who is in charge of Vahtacen, an Ayleid ruin site that the Mages Guild is exploring to find Ayleid artifacts. Depending on the time of day, Irlav can be found upstairs in the Arch-Mage's Tower or in the lobby with Raminus. Irlav will forward you to Skaleel who is currently in charge of the research at Vahtacen. It seems she has reported that there is a blocked passage. He gives you a key to the ruins and tells you to go to Vahtacen and speak with Skaleel about solving the problem.

1. Talk to Raminus Polus then Irlav Jarol to get your assignment. You are required to check up on the progress of research at Vahtacen, an Ayleid ruin.
2. At Vahtacen, solve a puzzle to gain access to the inner depths of the ruin.
3. Explore the ruin and retrieve an Ayleid artifact.
4. Take the artifact back to Irlav Jarol then report to Raminus Polus for your promotion.

**What-If Crucible:**
An ancient Ayleid pillar in the ruin of Vahtacen repels spells with violent elemental backlash. (A) Decode the ancient Welkynd inscriptions and cast the four elemental spells in exact order: unlocks the secret chamber peacefully and retrieves the Ayleid helmet for Irlav Jarol. (B) Use brute-force magical warding to withstand the pillar's backlashes: forces your way through the arcane barrier through sheer resilience, bypassing the intellectual puzzle. (C) Loot the untouched Welkynd stones and Ayleid artifacts for personal research: plunders the excavation site before handing over the mission objective.

quests.name: Vampire Cure
quests.title: Vampire Cure
quests.description: A long quest to gain the cure for Vampirism
quests.notes:
A long quest to gain the cure for Vampirism

**Canonical Outcome:**
Before you can start this quest, you must be a full fledged vampire, not just have the disease porphyric hemophilia. At that point, "Cure for Vampirism" will show up as a conversation topic, in particular when talking with healers or with Vicente Valtieri. Asking about "Cure Vampirism" will lead to a referral to Raminus Polus at the Arcane University in the Imperial City. But in fact, Raminus doesn't know much, other than that Count Janus Hassildor of Skingrad is a vampire, and may have been doing some research on a cure. At Castle Skingrad, ask the Steward Hal-Liurz for an audience with the Count. Talking to Hassildor yields an interesting backstory on him and his wife and reveals that he will reward you for obtaining a Cure Vampirism potion for his sick wife. But he tells you of a rumor of an alleged witch of Glenmoril who lives somewhere near the Corbolo River (your map places a marker at Drakelowe.)

1. Work your way through various referrals: from Raminus Polus, to Count Janus Hassildor of Skingrad to Melisande in Drakelowe.
2. Retrieve five empty Grand Soul Gems to get Melisande to help you.
3. Collect a long list of ingredients for the potion.
4. Retrieve the potion, and take it back to Janus Hassildor for a reward.

**What-If Crucible:**
Afflicted with vampirism, you seek Melisande of Drakelowe to brew the cure, which Count Hassildor also desperately needs for his wife. (A) Gather the five Grand Soul Gems, blood of an Argonian, nightshade, and garlic, brew the potion, and save yourself and Countess Hassildor: cures your curse and earns Hassildor's eternal gratitude. (B) Keep the single dose of cure for yourself: cures your own vampirism, leaving Countess Rona Hassildor to suffer in eternal agony. (C) Refuse the cure and master your vampiric powers: chooses the eternal night, becoming Cyrodiil's ultimate apex predator.
